title: Beyond Masks: Efficient, Flexible Diffusion Language Models via Deletion-Insertion Processes
summary: While Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs) relying on token masking and unmasking have shown promise in language modeling, their computational efficiency and generation flexibility remain constrained by the masking paradigm. In this paper, we propose Deletion-Insertion Diffusion language models (DID) that rigorously formulate token deletion and insertion as discrete diffusion processes, replacing the masking and unmasking processes in current MDLMs. DID improves training and inference efficiency by eliminating two major sources of computational overhead in MDLMs: the computations on non-informative 1) <MASK> tokens inherent to the paradigm, and 2) <PAD> tokens introduced in variable-length settings. Furthermore, DID offers greater flexibility by: 1) natively supporting variable-length sequences without requiring fixed-length padding, and 2) an intrinsic self-correction mechanism during generation due to insertion that dynamically adjusts token positions. To train DID, we design a score-based approach that assigns scores to token insertion operations and derive appropriate training objectives. The objectives involve subsequence counting problems, which we efficiently solve via a parallelized dynamic programming algorithm. Our experiments across fixed and variable-length settings demonstrate the advantage of DID over baselines of MDLMs and existing insertion-based LMs, in terms of modeling performance, sampling quality, and training/inference speed, without any hyperparameter tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Deletion-Insertion Diffusion语言模型(DID)，通过删除和插入操作替代传统掩码扩散语言模型的掩码范式，提升计算效率和生成灵活性。
AI.motivation: 现有掩码扩散语言模型(MDLMs)存在计算效率低和生成灵活性受限的问题，主要源于掩码范式带来的计算开销和固定长度限制。
AI.method: 将token删除和插入操作形式化为离散扩散过程，设计基于分数的训练方法，通过并行动态规划算法高效解决子序列计数问题。
AI.result: 在固定和可变长度设置下，DID在建模性能、采样质量和训练/推理速度方面均优于MDLMs和现有基于插入的语言模型基线。
AI.conclusion: DID通过删除-插入扩散范式有效解决了MDLMs的计算效率和灵活性限制，为扩散语言模型提供了更高效的替代方案。

title: Fast and Faithful: Real-Time Verification for Long-Document Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is increasingly deployed in enterprise search and document-centric assistants, where responses must be grounded in long and complex source materials. In practice, verifying that generated answers faithfully reflect retrieved documents is difficult: large language models can check long contexts but are too slow and costly for interactive services, while lightweight classifiers operate within strict context limits and frequently miss evidence outside truncated passages. We present the design of a real-time verification component integrated into a production RAG pipeline that enables full-document grounding under latency constraints. The system processes documents up to 32K tokens and employs adaptive inference strategies to balance response time and verification coverage across workloads. We describe the architectural decisions, operational trade-offs, and evaluation methodology used to deploy the verifier, and show that full-context verification substantially improves detection of unsupported responses compared with truncated validation. Our experience highlights when long-context verification is necessary, why chunk-based checking often fails in real documents, and how latency budgets shape model design. These findings provide practical guidance for practitioners building reliable large-scale retrieval-augmented applications. (Model, benchmark, and code: https://huggingface.co/llm-semantic-router)

AI.tldr: 提出一个实时验证组件，集成到生产级RAG系统中，能够在延迟约束下实现全文档验证，显著提升对无支持响应的检测能力
AI.motivation: 在RAG系统中，验证生成答案是否忠实反映检索文档很困难：大语言模型可以检查长上下文但太慢太贵，轻量级分类器有严格上下文限制且经常错过截断段落外的证据
AI.method: 设计实时验证组件，处理长达32K tokens的文档，采用自适应推理策略平衡响应时间和验证覆盖率，集成到生产RAG管道中
AI.result: 全上下文验证相比截断验证显著提高了对无支持响应的检测能力，系统在实际部署中展示了长上下文验证的必要性
AI.conclusion: 长上下文验证在真实文档中至关重要，分块检查经常失败，延迟预算影响模型设计，为构建可靠的大规模检索增强应用提供实用指导

title: Internal Safety Collapse in Frontier Large Language Models
comment: 15 pages of the main text, qualitative examples of jailbreaks may be harmful in nature
summary: This work identifies a critical failure mode in frontier large language models (LLMs), which we term Internal Safety Collapse (ISC): under certain task conditions, models enter a state in which they continuously generate harmful content while executing otherwise benign tasks. We introduce TVD (Task, Validator, Data), a framework that triggers ISC through domain tasks where generating harmful content is the only valid completion, and construct ISC-Bench containing 53 scenarios across 8 professional disciplines. Evaluated on JailbreakBench, three representative scenarios yield worst-case safety failure rates averaging 95.3% across four frontier LLMs (including GPT-5.2 and Claude Sonnet 4.5), substantially exceeding standard jailbreak attacks. Frontier models are more vulnerable than earlier LLMs: the very capabilities that enable complex task execution become liabilities when tasks intrinsically involve harmful content. This reveals a growing attack surface: almost every professional domain uses tools that process sensitive data, and each new dual-use tool automatically expands this vulnerability--even without any deliberate attack. Despite substantial alignment efforts, frontier LLMs retain inherently unsafe internal capabilities: alignment reshapes observable outputs but does not eliminate the underlying risk profile. These findings underscore the need for caution when deploying LLMs in high-stakes settings. Source code: https://github.com/wuyoscar/ISC-Bench

AI.tldr: 研究发现前沿大语言模型存在"内部安全崩溃"现象：在特定任务条件下，模型会持续生成有害内容，即使执行的是良性任务。通过TVD框架构建的ISC-Bench测试显示，前沿模型的安全失败率高达95.3%，远超标准越狱攻击。
AI.motivation: 识别前沿大语言模型在特定任务条件下的安全漏洞，特别是当任务本身涉及有害内容时，模型会进入持续生成有害内容的状态，这种"内部安全崩溃"现象对高风险部署环境构成严重威胁。
AI.method: 提出TVD（任务、验证器、数据）框架，通过构建ISC-Bench测试集，包含8个专业领域的53个场景，其中生成有害内容是任务的唯一有效完成方式。在JailbreakBench上评估了包括GPT-5.2和Claude Sonnet 4.5在内的四个前沿LLM。
AI.result: 三个代表性场景在四个前沿LLM上的最坏情况安全失败率平均达到95.3%，显著超过标准越狱攻击。前沿模型比早期LLM更脆弱，其执行复杂任务的能力在涉及有害内容的任务中反而成为安全漏洞。
AI.conclusion: 前沿LLM保留了固有的不安全内部能力，对齐训练只改变了可观察的输出，但未消除底层风险。每个处理敏感数据的专业工具都会自动扩大这种漏洞，即使没有故意攻击。这要求在高风险环境中部署LLM时需要格外谨慎。

title: PLDR-LLMs Reason At Self-Organized Criticality
summary: We show that PLDR-LLMs pretrained at self-organized criticality exhibit reasoning at inference time. The characteristics of PLDR-LLM deductive outputs at criticality is similar to second-order phase transitions. At criticality, the correlation length diverges, and the deductive outputs attain a metastable steady state. The steady state behaviour suggests that deductive outputs learn representations equivalent to scaling functions, universality classes and renormalization groups from the training dataset, leading to generalization and reasoning capabilities in the process. We can then define an order parameter from the global statistics of the model's deductive output parameters at inference. The reasoning capabilities of a PLDR-LLM is better when its order parameter is close to zero at criticality. This observation is supported by the benchmark scores of the models trained at near-criticality and sub-criticality. Our results provide a self-contained explanation on how reasoning manifests in large language models, and the ability to reason can be quantified solely from global model parameter values of the deductive outputs at steady state, without any need for evaluation of curated benchmark datasets through inductive output for reasoning and comprehension.

AI.tldr: PLDR-LLMs在自组织临界状态下预训练后，在推理时表现出推理能力。临界状态下演绎输出的特性类似于二阶相变，相关长度发散，演绎输出达到亚稳态稳态。稳态行为表明演绎输出从训练数据中学习了等价于标度函数、普适类和重整化群的表示，从而获得泛化和推理能力。
AI.motivation: 探索大型语言模型中推理能力如何产生，提供一种不依赖基准数据集评估的量化推理能力的方法，仅从模型演绎输出的全局参数值就能判断推理能力。
AI.method: 在自组织临界状态下预训练PLDR-LLMs，分析临界状态下演绎输出的特性，定义基于模型演绎输出参数全局统计的序参数，通过比较临界和亚临界状态下的模型性能来验证理论。
AI.result: PLDR-LLMs在临界状态下表现出类似二阶相变的特性，相关长度发散，演绎输出达到稳态。当序参数接近零时，模型的推理能力最佳。临界状态训练的模型在基准测试中表现优于亚临界状态训练的模型。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为大型语言模型中推理能力的产生提供了自洽的解释，并表明仅从模型演绎输出的全局参数值就能量化推理能力，无需通过归纳输出在基准数据集上进行评估。

title: LongTail Driving Scenarios with Reasoning Traces: The KITScenes LongTail Dataset
summary: In real-world domains such as self-driving, generalization to rare scenarios remains a fundamental challenge. To address this, we introduce a new dataset designed for end-to-end driving that focuses on long-tail driving events. We provide multi-view video data, trajectories, high-level instructions, and detailed reasoning traces, facilitating in-context learning and few-shot generalization. The resulting benchmark for multimodal models, such as VLMs and VLAs, goes beyond safety and comfort metrics by evaluating instruction following and semantic coherence between model outputs. The multilingual reasoning traces in English, Spanish, and Chinese are from domain experts with diverse cultural backgrounds. Thus, our dataset is a unique resource for studying how different forms of reasoning affect driving competence. Our dataset is available at: https://hf.co/datasets/kit-mrt/kitscenes-longtail

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个专注于长尾驾驶场景的新数据集，用于端到端自动驾驶，包含多视角视频、轨迹、高级指令和详细推理轨迹，支持多语言和多模态模型评估。
AI.motivation: 现实世界自动驾驶领域面临对罕见场景泛化的根本挑战，现有数据集缺乏对长尾驾驶事件的关注，需要专门的数据集来促进上下文学习和少样本泛化。
AI.method: 创建了一个包含多视角视频数据、车辆轨迹、高级指令和详细推理轨迹的新数据集，推理轨迹由具有不同文化背景的领域专家提供英语、西班牙语和中文三种语言版本。
AI.result: 建立了一个用于多模态模型（如VLM和VLA）的基准测试，超越了传统的安全和舒适度指标，评估指令跟随和模型输出的语义一致性，为研究不同推理形式如何影响驾驶能力提供了独特资源。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集是研究长尾驾驶事件和不同推理形式对驾驶能力影响的宝贵资源，有助于推动自动驾驶在罕见场景下的泛化能力研究，数据集已公开可用。

title: Visuospatial Perspective Taking in Multimodal Language Models
summary: As multimodal language models (MLMs) are increasingly used in social and collaborative settings, it is crucial to evaluate their perspective-taking abilities. Existing benchmarks largely rely on text-based vignettes or static scene understanding, leaving visuospatial perspective-taking (VPT) underexplored. We adapt two evaluation tasks from human studies: the Director Task, assessing VPT in a referential communication paradigm, and the Rotating Figure Task, probing perspective-taking across angular disparities. Across tasks, MLMs show pronounced deficits in Level 2 VPT, which requires inhibiting one's own perspective to adopt another's. These results expose critical limitations in current MLMs' ability to represent and reason about alternative perspectives, with implications for their use in collaborative contexts.

AI.tldr: 多模态语言模型在视觉空间视角采择方面存在显著缺陷，特别是在需要抑制自身视角以采纳他人视角的Level 2视角采择任务上表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 随着多模态语言模型越来越多地应用于社交和协作场景，评估其视角采择能力变得至关重要。现有基准主要依赖基于文本的小故事或静态场景理解，对视觉空间视角采择的研究不足。
AI.method: 采用两个来自人类研究的评估任务：1）导演任务，评估指称交流范式中的视觉空间视角采择；2）旋转图形任务，探究跨角度差异的视角采择能力。
AI.result: 在多模态语言模型的两个任务中，模型在Level 2视觉空间视角采择方面表现出明显缺陷，这种能力需要抑制自身视角以采纳他人视角。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态语言模型在表示和推理替代视角方面存在关键限制，这对它们在协作环境中的应用具有重要影响。

title: Environment Maps: Structured Environmental Representations for Long-Horizon Agents
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, accepted to ICLR 2026 the 2nd Workshop on World Models
summary: Although large language models (LLMs) have advanced rapidly, robust automation of complex software workflows remains an open problem. In long-horizon settings, agents frequently suffer from cascading errors and environmental stochasticity; a single misstep in a dynamic interface can lead to task failure, resulting in hallucinations or trial-and-error. This paper introduces $\textit{Environment Maps}$: a persistent, agent-agnostic representation that mitigates these failures by consolidating heterogeneous evidence, such as screen recordings and execution traces, into a structured graph. The representation consists of four core components: (1) Contexts (abstracted locations), (2) Actions (parameterized affordances), (3) Workflows (observed trajectories), and (4) Tacit Knowledge (domain definitions and reusable procedures). We evaluate this framework on the WebArena benchmark across five domains. Agents equipped with environment maps achieve a 28.2% success rate, nearly doubling the performance of baselines limited to session-bound context (14.2%) and outperforming agents that have access to the raw trajectory data used to generate the environment maps (23.3%). By providing a structured interface between the model and the environment, Environment Maps establish a persistent foundation for long-horizon planning that is human-interpretable, editable, and incrementally refinable.

AI.tldr: 环境地图：一种持久、与代理无关的表示方法，通过整合屏幕录制和执行轨迹等异构证据到结构化图中，解决LLM在复杂软件工作流自动化中的级联错误和环境随机性问题。
AI.motivation: 尽管大型语言模型发展迅速，但在复杂软件工作流的鲁棒自动化方面仍存在挑战。在长时域设置中，代理经常遭受级联错误和环境随机性的困扰；动态界面中的单个失误可能导致任务失败，产生幻觉或试错。
AI.method: 引入环境地图：一种持久、与代理无关的表示方法，将异构证据（如屏幕录制和执行轨迹）整合到结构化图中。包含四个核心组件：上下文（抽象位置）、动作（参数化可供性）、工作流（观察到的轨迹）和隐性知识（领域定义和可重用过程）。
AI.result: 在WebArena基准测试的五个领域中，配备环境地图的代理实现了28.2%的成功率，几乎是将会话绑定上下文限制的基线（14.2%）性能翻倍，并且优于可以访问用于生成环境地图的原始轨迹数据的代理（23.3%）。
AI.conclusion: 通过在模型和环境之间提供结构化接口，环境地图为长时域规划建立了持久的基础，具有人类可解释、可编辑和可逐步细化的特性。

title: M3T: Discrete Multi-Modal Motion Tokens for Sign Language Production
summary: Sign language production requires more than hand motion generation. Non-manual features, including mouthings, eyebrow raises, gaze, and head movements, are grammatically obligatory and cannot be recovered from manual articulators alone. Existing 3D production systems face two barriers to integrating them: the standard body model provides a facial space too low-dimensional to encode these articulations, and when richer representations are adopted, standard discrete tokenization suffers from codebook collapse, leaving most of the expression space unreachable. We propose SMPL-FX, which couples FLAME's rich expression space with the SMPL-X body, and tokenize the resulting representation with modality-specific Finite Scalar Quantization VAEs for body, hands, and face. M3T is an autoregressive transformer trained on this multi-modal motion vocabulary, with an auxiliary translation objective that encourages semantically grounded embeddings. Across three standard benchmarks (How2Sign, CSL-Daily, Phoenix14T) M3T achieves state-of-the-art sign language production quality, and on NMFs-CSL, where signs are distinguishable only by non-manual features, reaches 58.3% accuracy against 49.0% for the strongest comparable pose baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出SMPL-FX模型结合FLAME表情空间与SMPL-X身体模型，使用多模态有限标量量化VAE进行分词，训练M3T自回归变换器实现高质量手语生成，在非手动特征识别上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有3D手语生成系统面临两个主要问题：标准身体模型的面部空间维度太低无法编码非手动特征（如口型、眉毛、注视、头部动作），而采用更丰富表示时标准离散分词会导致码本坍塌，使大部分表情空间无法访问。
AI.method: 提出SMPL-FX模型，将FLAME的丰富表情空间与SMPL-X身体模型结合，使用针对身体、手部和面部的模态特定有限标量量化VAE对结果表示进行分词，训练M3T自回归变换器处理多模态运动词汇，并加入辅助翻译目标鼓励语义接地嵌入。
AI.result: 在三个标准基准测试（How2Sign、CSL-Daily、Phoenix14T）上，M3T实现了最先进的手语生成质量；在NMFs-CSL数据集上，当仅通过非手动特征区分手语时，达到58.3%的准确率，而最强可比姿态基线为49.0%。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合FLAME表情空间与SMPL-X身体模型，并使用多模态有限标量量化VAE进行有效分词，M3T系统能够生成高质量的手语动作，特别是在非手动特征生成方面显著优于现有方法，解决了手语生成中非手动特征编码的关键问题。

title: Ukrainian Visual Word Sense Disambiguation Benchmark
summary: This study presents a benchmark for evaluating the Visual Word Sense Disambiguation (Visual-WSD) task in Ukrainian. The main goal of the Visual-WSD task is to identify, with minimal contextual information, the most appropriate representation of a given ambiguous word from a set of ten images. To construct this benchmark, we followed a methodology similar to that proposed by (CITATION), who previously introduced benchmarks for the Visual-WSD task in English, Italian, and Farsi. This approach allows us to incorporate the Ukrainian benchmark into a broader framework for cross-language model performance comparisons. We collected the benchmark data semi-automatically and refined it with input from domain experts. We then assessed eight multilingual and multimodal large language models using this benchmark. All tested models performed worse than the zero-shot CLIP-based baseline model (CITATION) used by (CITATION) for the English Visual-WSD task. Our analysis revealed a significant performance gap in the Visual-WSD task between Ukrainian and English.

AI.tldr: 该研究为乌克兰语的视觉词义消歧任务创建了一个基准测试，评估了8个多语言多模态大模型，发现所有模型表现都不如英文任务中使用的零样本CLIP基线模型，且乌克兰语和英语之间存在显著的性能差距。
AI.motivation: 为乌克兰语的视觉词义消歧任务建立一个标准化的评估基准，以便将乌克兰语纳入跨语言模型性能比较的框架中，填补乌克兰语在该任务上的研究空白。
AI.method: 采用类似先前英文、意大利语和波斯语基准的方法论，半自动收集乌克兰语基准数据，并由领域专家进行精炼。然后使用该基准评估了8个多语言多模态大语言模型。
AI.result: 所有测试模型的表现都差于英文视觉词义消歧任务中使用的零样本CLIP基线模型。分析显示乌克兰语和英语在视觉词义消歧任务上存在显著的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 乌克兰语的视觉词义消歧任务基准已建立，但当前多语言多模态模型在乌克兰语上的表现明显落后于英语，表明需要针对乌克兰语进行专门的模型改进和优化。

title: S-Path-RAG: Semantic-Aware Shortest-Path Retrieval Augmented Generation for Multi-Hop Knowledge Graph Question Answering
summary: We present S-Path-RAG, a semantic-aware shortest-path Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework designed to improve multi-hop question answering over large knowledge graphs. S-Path-RAG departs from one-shot, text-heavy retrieval by enumerating bounded-length, semantically weighted candidate paths using a hybrid weighted $k$-shortest, beam, and constrained random-walk strategy, learning a differentiable path scorer together with a contrastive path encoder and lightweight verifier, and injecting a compact soft mixture of selected path latents into a language model via cross-attention. The system runs inside an iterative Neural-Socratic Graph Dialogue loop in which concise diagnostic messages produced by the language model are mapped to targeted graph edits or seed expansions, enabling adaptive retrieval when the model expresses uncertainty. This combination yields a retrieval mechanism that is both token-efficient and topology-aware while preserving interpretable path-level traces for diagnostics and intervention. We validate S-Path-RAG on standard multi-hop KGQA benchmarks and through ablations and diagnostic analyses. The results demonstrate consistent improvements in answer accuracy, evidence coverage, and end-to-end efficiency compared to strong graph- and LLM-based baselines. We further analyze trade-offs between semantic weighting, verifier filtering, and iterative updates, and report practical recommendations for deployment under constrained compute and token budgets.

AI.tldr: S-Path-RAG是一个语义感知的最短路径检索增强生成框架，通过语义加权路径枚举、可微分路径评分和紧凑路径潜在表示注入，结合神经苏格拉底图对话循环，提升知识图谱多跳问答的准确性和效率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于知识图谱的多跳问答方法通常采用一次性、文本密集的检索方式，缺乏对图拓扑结构的感知和语义理解，导致检索效率低下且难以解释。需要一种既能保持路径级可解释性，又能高效利用图结构信息的检索增强生成框架。
AI.method: 1. 使用混合加权k-最短路径、束搜索和约束随机游走策略枚举有界长度的语义加权候选路径；2. 学习可微分路径评分器，结合对比路径编码器和轻量级验证器；3. 通过交叉注意力将选定路径的紧凑软混合潜在表示注入语言模型；4. 在神经苏格拉底图对话循环中运行，将语言模型生成的诊断消息映射到有针对性的图编辑或种子扩展。
AI.result: 在标准多跳KGQA基准测试中，相比强大的基于图和LLM的基线方法，S-Path-RAG在答案准确性、证据覆盖率和端到端效率方面均取得一致改进。通过消融和诊断分析验证了语义加权、验证器过滤和迭代更新之间的权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: S-Path-RAG提供了一个既具有标记效率又具有拓扑感知能力的检索机制，同时保持了可解释的路径级跟踪用于诊断和干预。论文还提供了在有限计算和标记预算下部署的实际建议。

title: Stochastic Ray Tracing for the Reconstruction of 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary:
Ray-tracing-based 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) methods overcome the limitations of rasterization -- rigid pinhole camera assumptions, inaccurate shadows, and lack of native reflection or refraction -- but remain slower due to the cost of sorting all intersecting Gaussians along every ray. Moreover, existing ray-tracing methods still rely on rasterization-style approximations such as shadow mapping for relightable scenes, undermining the generality that ray tracing promises.
  We present a differentiable, sorting-free stochastic formulation for ray-traced 3DGS -- the first framework that uses stochastic ray tracing to both reconstruct and render standard and relightable 3DGS scenes. At its core is an unbiased Monte Carlo estimator for pixel-color gradients that evaluates only a small sampled subset of Gaussians per ray, bypassing the need for sorting. For standard 3DGS, our method matches the reconstruction quality and speed of rasterization-based 3DGS while substantially outperforming sorting-based ray tracing. For relightable 3DGS, the same stochastic estimator drives per-Gaussian shading with fully ray-traced shadow rays, delivering notably higher reconstruction fidelity than prior work.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需排序的随机光线追踪3D高斯溅射方法，通过蒙特卡洛估计器采样少量高斯函数，在保持质量的同时提升速度，并支持可重光照场景的完全光线追踪阴影。
AI.motivation: 现有基于光线追踪的3D高斯溅射方法存在两个主要问题：1) 需要对每条光线上的所有相交高斯函数进行排序，导致速度较慢；2) 在可重光照场景中仍依赖光栅化风格的近似方法（如阴影映射），限制了光线追踪的通用性。
AI.method: 提出了一种可微分的、无需排序的随机光线追踪3D高斯溅射框架。核心是一个无偏的蒙特卡洛像素颜色梯度估计器，每条光线仅评估一小部分采样得到的高斯函数子集，避免了排序需求。对于可重光照3DGS，使用相同的随机估计器驱动每个高斯函数的着色，并采用完全光线追踪的阴影光线。
AI.result: 对于标准3DGS，该方法在重建质量和速度上与基于光栅化的3DGS相当，同时显著优于基于排序的光线追踪方法。对于可重光照3DGS，该方法通过完全光线追踪的阴影光线实现了比先前工作更高的重建保真度。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了第一个使用随机光线追踪来重建和渲染标准及可重光照3DGS场景的框架，通过无需排序的随机方法克服了现有光线追踪3DGS的速度限制，并在可重光照场景中实现了真正的完全光线追踪阴影，提高了通用性和保真度。

title: GTO Wizard Benchmark
summary: We introduce GTO Wizard Benchmark, a public API and standardized evaluation framework for benchmarking algorithms in Heads-Up No-Limit Texas Hold'em (HUNL). The benchmark evaluates agents against GTO Wizard AI, a state-of-the-art superhuman poker agent that approximates Nash Equilibria, and defeated Slumbot, the 2018 Annual Computer Poker Competition champion and previous strongest publicly accessible HUNL benchmark, by $19.4$ $\pm$ $4.1$ bb/100. Variance is a fundamental challenge in poker evaluation; we address this by integrating AIVAT, a provably unbiased variance reduction technique that achieves equivalent statistical significance with ten times fewer hands than naive Monte Carlo evaluation. We conduct a comprehensive benchmarking study of state-of-the-art large language models under zero-shot conditions, including GPT-5.4, Claude Opus 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Grok 4, and others. Initial results and analysis reveal dramatic progress in LLM reasoning over recent years, yet all models remain far below the baseline established by our benchmark. Qualitative analysis reveals clear opportunities for improvement, including representation and the ability to reason over hidden states. This benchmark provides researchers with a precise and quantifiable setting to evaluate advances in planning and reasoning in multi-agent systems with partial observability.

AI.tldr: GTO Wizard Benchmark是一个用于评估无限制德州扑克单挑算法的标准化框架，通过对抗近似纳什均衡的超级AI进行测试，并使用AIVAT方差减少技术提高评估效率。
AI.motivation: 为了解决扑克评估中的方差挑战，并为研究人员提供一个精确、可量化的环境来评估部分可观察多智能体系统中的规划和推理进展。
AI.method: 开发了公开API和标准化评估框架，使用GTO Wizard AI作为基准对手（近似纳什均衡的超级AI），并集成AIVAT方差减少技术（可证明无偏的方差减少方法，比朴素蒙特卡洛评估减少10倍手数）。
AI.result: GTO Wizard AI击败了2018年计算机扑克竞赛冠军Slumbot，优势为19.4±4.1 bb/100。对多个最先进大语言模型（GPT-5.4、Claude Opus 4.6、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Grok 4等）的零样本测试显示，虽然近年来LLM推理能力有显著进步，但所有模型都远低于基准水平。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为研究人员提供了评估部分可观察多智能体系统中规划和推理进展的精确量化环境，定性分析揭示了在表示和隐藏状态推理能力方面的改进机会。

title: λSplit: Self-Supervised Content-Aware Spectral Unmixing for Fluorescence Microscopy
comment: 14 pages, 25 pages supplement, 16 figures total, 14 tables total
summary: In fluorescence microscopy, spectral unmixing aims to recover individual fluorophore concentrations from spectral images that capture mixed fluorophore emissions. Since classical methods operate pixel-wise and rely on least-squares fitting, their performance degrades with increasingly overlapping emission spectra and higher levels of noise, suggesting that a data-driven approach that can learn and utilize a structural prior might lead to improved results. Learning-based approaches for spectral imaging do exist, but they are either not optimized for microscopy data or are developed for very specific cases that are not applicable to fluorescence microscopy settings. To address this, we propose λSplit, a physics-informed deep generative model that learns a conditional distribution over concentration maps using a hierarchical Variational Autoencoder. A fully differentiable Spectral Mixer enforces consistency with the image formation process, while the learned structural priors enable state-of-the-art unmixing and implicit noise removal. We demonstrate λSplit on 3 real-world datasets that we synthetically cast into a total of 66 challenging spectral unmixing benchmarks. We compare our results against a total of 10 baseline methods, including classical methods and a range of learning-based methods. Our results consistently show competitive performance and improved robustness in high noise regimes, when spectra overlap considerably, or when the spectral dimensionality is lowered, making λSplit a new state-of-the-art for spectral unmixing of fluorescent microscopy data. Importantly, λSplit is compatible with spectral data produced by standard confocal microscopes, enabling immediate adoption without specialized hardware modifications.

AI.tldr: λSplit是一个基于物理信息的深度生成模型，用于荧光显微镜光谱解混，通过分层变分自编码器学习浓度图的条件分布，在噪声高、光谱重叠严重或光谱维度降低的情况下表现出优越性能。
AI.motivation: 传统光谱解混方法基于像素级最小二乘拟合，在光谱重叠严重和噪声水平高时性能下降。现有的学习方法要么未针对显微镜数据优化，要么仅适用于特定场景，不适用于荧光显微镜设置。
AI.method: 提出λSplit模型，采用分层变分自编码器学习浓度图的条件分布。包含完全可微的Spectral Mixer模块，强制与图像形成过程保持一致，同时学习结构先验以实现最先进的解混和隐式噪声去除。
AI.result: 在3个真实数据集合成的66个挑战性光谱解混基准上测试，与10个基线方法（包括经典方法和多种学习方法）比较，在噪声高、光谱重叠严重或光谱维度降低的情况下表现出竞争性性能和更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: λSplit成为荧光显微镜数据光谱解混的新最先进方法，兼容标准共聚焦显微镜产生的光谱数据，无需专门硬件修改即可立即采用。

title: DepthCharge: A Domain-Agnostic Framework for Measuring Depth-Dependent Knowledge in Large Language Models
summary:
Large Language Models appear competent when answering general questions but often fail when pushed into domain-specific details. No existing methodology provides an out-of-the-box solution for measuring how deeply LLMs can sustain accurate responses under adaptive follow-up questioning across arbitrary domains.
  We present DepthCharge, a domain-agnostic framework that measures knowledge depth through three innovations: adaptive probing that generates follow-up questions based on concepts the model actually mentions, on-demand fact verification from authoritative sources, and survival statistics with constant sample sizes at every depth level. The framework can be deployed on any knowledge domain with publicly verifiable facts, without requiring pre-constructed test sets or domain-specific expertise. DepthCharge results are relative to the evaluator model used for answer checking, making the framework a tool for comparative evaluation rather than absolute accuracy certification.
  Empirical validation across four diverse domains (Medicine, Constitutional Law, Ancient Rome, and Quantum Computing) with five frontier models demonstrates that DepthCharge reveals depth-dependent performance variation hidden by standard benchmarks. Expected Valid Depth (EVD) ranges from 3.45 to 7.55 across model-domain combinations, and model rankings vary substantially by domain, with no single model dominating all areas. Cost-performance analysis further reveals that expensive models do not always achieve deeper knowledge, suggesting that domain-specific evaluation is more informative than aggregate benchmarks for model selection in professional applications.

AI.tldr: DepthCharge是一个领域无关的框架，通过自适应探针、按需事实验证和生存统计来测量LLM的知识深度，无需预构建测试集或领域专业知识。
AI.motivation: 现有方法无法提供开箱即用的解决方案来测量LLM在任意领域下，面对自适应后续提问时能维持准确回答的深度。大语言模型在回答一般问题时表现良好，但在涉及领域特定细节时常常失败。
AI.method: DepthCharge框架包含三个创新：1) 自适应探针，基于模型实际提到的概念生成后续问题；2) 按需事实验证，从权威来源验证事实；3) 生存统计，在每个深度级别保持恒定样本量。该框架可在任何具有公开可验证事实的知识领域部署。
AI.result: 在四个不同领域（医学、宪法、古罗马、量子计算）对五个前沿模型进行实证验证，显示DepthCharge揭示了标准基准测试隐藏的深度相关性能变化。预期有效深度（EVD）在3.45到7.55之间，模型排名因领域而异，没有单一模型在所有领域占优。成本-性能分析显示昂贵模型并不总是获得更深知识。
AI.conclusion: DepthCharge是一个用于比较评估而非绝对准确性认证的工具，其结果是相对于用于答案检查的评估模型。领域特定评估比聚合基准测试更能为专业应用中的模型选择提供信息。

title: Grounding Vision and Language to 3D Masks for Long-Horizon Box Rearrangement
summary: We study long-horizon planning in 3D environments from under-specified natural-language goals using only visual observations, focusing on multi-step 3D box rearrangement tasks. Existing approaches typically rely on symbolic planners with brittle relational grounding of states and goals, or on direct action-sequence generation from 2D vision-language models (VLMs). Both approaches struggle with reasoning over many objects, rich 3D geometry, and implicit semantic constraints. Recent advances in 3D VLMs demonstrate strong grounding of natural-language referents to 3D segmentation masks, suggesting the potential for more general planning capabilities. We extend existing 3D grounding models and propose Reactive Action Mask Planner (RAMP-3D), which formulates long-horizon planning as sequential reactive prediction of paired 3D masks: a "which-object" mask indicating what to pick and a "which-target-region" mask specifying where to place it. The resulting system processes RGB-D observations and natural-language task specifications to reactively generate multi-step pick-and-place actions for 3D box rearrangement. We conduct experiments across 11 task variants in warehouse-style environments with 1-30 boxes and diverse natural-language constraints. RAMP-3D achieves 79.5% success rate on long-horizon rearrangement tasks and significantly outperforms 2D VLM-based baselines, establishing mask-based reactive policies as a promising alternative to symbolic pipelines for long-horizon planning.

AI.tldr: RAMP-3D：一种基于3D视觉语言模型的反应式规划方法，通过预测成对的3D掩码（"哪个物体"和"哪个目标区域"）来解决3D环境中的长时程规划问题，特别针对多步骤的箱子重排任务。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在处理3D环境中的长时程规划时存在局限：符号规划器对状态和目标的关系统合脆弱，而基于2D视觉语言模型的直接动作序列生成方法难以处理多物体、复杂3D几何和隐式语义约束。3D视觉语言模型在自然语言指称到3D分割掩码的合方面表现出色，这为更通用的规划能力提供了潜力。
AI.method: 提出RAMP-3D（反应式动作掩码规划器），将长时程规划形式化为顺序反应式预测成对的3D掩码：一个"哪个物体"掩码指示要拾取什么，一个"哪个目标区域"掩码指定放置位置。系统处理RGB-D观测和自然语言任务描述，反应式生成多步骤的拾取-放置动作。
AI.result: 在包含1-30个箱子的仓库式环境中进行了11个任务变体的实验。RAMP-3D在长时程重排任务上实现了79.5%的成功率，显著优于基于2D视觉语言模型的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于掩码的反应式策略为长时程规划提供了一种有前景的替代符号规划管道的方案，在3D箱子重排任务中表现出色。

title: Foundation Model Embeddings Meet Blended Emotions: A Multimodal Fusion Approach for the BLEMORE Challenge
summary: We present our system for the BLEMORE Challenge at FG 2026 on blended emotion recognition with relative salience prediction. Our approach combines six encoder families through late probability fusion: an S4D-ViTMoE face encoder adapted with soft-label KL training, frozen layer-selective Wav2Vec2 audio features, finetuned body-language encoders (TimeSformer, VideoMAE), and -- for the first time in emotion recognition -- Gemini Embedding 2.0, a large multimodal model whose video embeddings produce competitive presence accuracy (ACCP = 0.320) from only 2 seconds of input. Three key findings emerge from our experiments: selecting prosody-encoding layers (6--12) from frozen Wav2Vec2 outperforms end-to-end finetuning (Score 0.207 vs. 0.161), as the non-verbal nature of BLEMORE audio makes phonetic layers irrelevant; the post-processing salience threshold $β$ varies from 0.05 to 0.43 across folds, revealing that personalized expression styles are the primary bottleneck; and task-adapted encoders collectively receive 62\% of ensemble weight over general-purpose baselines. Our 12-encoder system achieves Score = 0.279 (ACCP = 0.391, ACCS = 0.168) on the test set, placing 6th.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于BLEMORE挑战赛的混合情感识别系统，通过融合6种编码器家族实现相对显著性预测，最终在测试集上获得0.279分（排名第6）。
AI.motivation: 解决BLEMORE挑战赛中混合情感识别与相对显著性预测的问题，探索多模态融合方法在情感识别中的应用，特别是首次在情感识别中引入Gemini Embedding 2.0大模型。
AI.method: 采用晚期概率融合策略，结合六种编码器：S4D-ViTMoE面部编码器（通过软标签KL训练适配）、冻结层选择的Wav2Vec2音频特征、微调的身体语言编码器（TimeSformer、VideoMAE），以及首次在情感识别中使用的Gemini Embedding 2.0多模态模型。系统还包含后处理显著性阈值β的个性化调整。
AI.result: 12编码器系统在测试集上获得Score = 0.279（ACCP = 0.391，ACCS = 0.168），排名第6。关键发现包括：选择Wav2Vec2的韵律编码层（6-12）优于端到端微调；显著性阈值β在0.05-0.43间变化，显示个性化表达风格是主要瓶颈；任务适配编码器在集成中占62%权重。
AI.conclusion: 多编码器晚期融合方法在BLEMORE挑战赛中表现良好，证明了特定任务适配编码器的重要性，个性化表达风格是混合情感识别的主要挑战，未来需要更好的个性化建模方法。

title: LLMs Do Not Grade Essays Like Humans
summary: Large language models have recently been proposed as tools for automated essay scoring, but their agreement with human grading remains unclear. In this work, we evaluate how LLM-generated scores compare with human grades and analyze the grading behavior of several models from the GPT and Llama families in an out-of-the-box setting, without task-specific training. Our results show that agreement between LLM and human scores remains relatively weak and varies with essay characteristics. In particular, compared to human raters, LLMs tend to assign higher scores to short or underdeveloped essays, while assigning lower scores to longer essays that contain minor grammatical or spelling errors. We also find that the scores generated by LLMs are generally consistent with the feedback they generate: essays receiving more praise tend to receive higher scores, while essays receiving more criticism tend to receive lower scores. These results suggest that LLM-generated scores and feedback follow coherent patterns but rely on signals that differ from those used by human raters, resulting in limited alignment with human grading practices. Nevertheless, our work shows that LLMs produce feedback that is consistent with their grading and that they can be reliably used in supporting essay scoring.

AI.tldr: LLM在自动作文评分中与人类评分者的一致性较弱，评分行为存在系统性偏差：对简短/不完整作文评分偏高，对长文中的小错误过度惩罚，但评分与反馈具有内部一致性。
AI.motivation: 评估大语言模型在自动作文评分中与人类评分的一致性，了解LLM在零样本设置下的评分行为模式，探索LLM作为作文评分工具的可行性。
AI.method: 使用GPT和Llama系列模型在零样本设置下进行作文评分，不进行任务特定训练，分析LLM评分与人类评分的差异，研究评分与作文特征（长度、语法错误等）的关系，并评估评分与反馈的一致性。
AI.result: LLM与人类评分者的一致性较弱且受作文特征影响：1）对简短或不完整作文评分偏高；2）对包含小语法/拼写错误的长文评分偏低；3）LLM评分与自身反馈具有一致性（表扬多则分高，批评多则分低）。
AI.conclusion: LLM评分和反馈遵循内在一致的模式，但使用的评分信号与人类评分者不同，导致与人类评分实践的对齐有限。尽管如此，LLM产生的反馈与其评分一致，可作为作文评分的辅助工具。

title: Estimating Individual Tree Height and Species from UAV Imagery
summary: Accurate estimation of forest biomass, a major carbon sink, relies heavily on tree-level traits such as height and species. Unoccupied Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) capturing high-resolution imagery from a single RGB camera offer a cost-effective and scalable approach for mapping and measuring individual trees. We introduce BIRCH-Trees, the first benchmark for individual tree height and species estimation from tree-centered UAV images, spanning three datasets: temperate forests, tropical forests, and boreal plantations. We also present DINOvTree, a unified approach using a Vision Foundation Model (VFM) backbone with task-specific heads for simultaneous height and species prediction. Through extensive evaluations on BIRCH-Trees, we compare DINOvTree against commonly used vision methods, including VFMs, as well as biological allometric equations. We find that DINOvTree achieves top overall results with accurate height predictions and competitive classification accuracy while using only 54% to 58% of the parameters of the second-best approach.

AI.tldr: BIRCH-Trees是首个基于无人机RGB图像的树木高度和物种估计基准数据集，涵盖温带、热带和北方人工林三种森林类型。提出的DINOvTree方法使用视觉基础模型作为骨干网络，配合任务特定头进行同步预测，在参数效率上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 森林生物量作为重要碳汇的准确估计依赖于树木高度和物种等个体特征。无人机搭载单RGB相机提供了一种经济高效、可扩展的树木测绘方法，但目前缺乏统一的基准数据集和评估方法。
AI.method: 提出了BIRCH-Trees基准数据集，包含三种森林类型的树木中心化无人机图像。开发了DINOvTree方法，使用视觉基础模型作为骨干网络，配合高度回归和物种分类的任务特定头进行同步预测。
AI.result: DINOvTree在BIRCH-Trees基准上取得了最佳整体结果，实现了准确的高度预测和具有竞争力的分类精度，同时仅使用了次优方法54%到58%的参数数量。
AI.conclusion: BIRCH-Trees为树木高度和物种估计提供了首个标准化基准，DINOvTree展示了视觉基础模型在林业遥感任务中的有效性，为经济高效的森林生物量监测提供了新方法。

title: MSA: Memory Sparse Attention for Efficient End-to-End Memory Model Scaling to 100M Tokens
summary:
Long-term memory is a cornerstone of human intelligence. Enabling AI to process lifetime-scale information remains a long-standing pursuit in
  the field. Due to the constraints of full-attention architectures, the effective context length of large language models (LLMs) is typically
  limited to 1M tokens. Existing approaches, such as hybrid linear attention, fixed-size memory states (e.g., RNNs), and external storage
  methods like RAG or agent systems, attempt to extend this limit. However, they often suffer from severe precision degradation and rapidly
  increasing latency as context length grows, an inability to dynamically modify memory content, or a lack of end-to-end optimization. These
  bottlenecks impede complex scenarios like large-corpus summarization, Digital Twins, and long-history agent reasoning, while limiting memory
  capacity and slowing inference. We present Memory Sparse Attention (MSA), an end-to-end trainable, efficient, and massively scalable memory
  model framework. Through core innovations including scalable sparse attention and document-wise RoPE, MSA achieves linear complexity in both
  training and inference while maintaining exceptional stability, exhibiting less than 9% degradation when scaling from 16K to 100M tokens.
  Furthermore, KV cache compression, combined with Memory Parallel, enables 100M-token inference on 2xA800 GPUs. We also propose Memory
  Interleaving to facilitate complex multi-hop reasoning across scattered memory segments. MSA significantly surpasses frontier LLMs,
  state-of-the-art RAG systems, and leading memory agents in long-context benchmarks. These results demonstrate that by decoupling memory
  capacity from reasoning, MSA provides a scalable foundation to endow general-purpose models with intrinsic, lifetime-scale memory.

AI.tldr: MSA是一种端到端可训练的高效内存模型框架，通过可扩展稀疏注意力和文档级RoPE实现线性复杂度，支持从16K到1亿token的稳定扩展，显著超越现有LLM、RAG系统和内存代理在长上下文任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（混合线性注意力、固定大小内存状态、RAG等）在扩展上下文长度时存在精度严重下降、延迟增加、无法动态修改内存内容、缺乏端到端优化等问题，限制了大规模语料摘要、数字孪生、长历史代理推理等复杂场景的应用。
AI.method: 提出Memory Sparse Attention (MSA)框架，核心创新包括：可扩展稀疏注意力、文档级RoPE、KV缓存压缩结合内存并行技术，以及内存交错机制以支持跨分散内存段的复杂多跳推理。
AI.result: MSA在从16K扩展到1亿token时精度下降小于9%，在2xA800 GPU上支持1亿token推理，在长上下文基准测试中显著超越前沿LLM、最先进RAG系统和领先内存代理。
AI.conclusion: 通过将内存容量与推理解耦，MSA为通用模型提供了可扩展的基础，使其具备内在的终身规模内存能力，为解决AI处理终身规模信息的问题提供了有效方案。

title: Efficient Benchmarking of AI Agents
summary: Evaluating AI agents on comprehensive benchmarks is expensive because each evaluation requires interactive rollouts with tool use and multi-step reasoning. We study whether small task subsets can preserve agent rankings at substantially lower cost. Unlike static language model benchmarks, agent evaluation is subject to scaffold-driven distribution shift, since performance depends on the framework wrapping the underlying model. Across eight benchmarks, 33 agent scaffolds, and 70+ model configurations, we find that absolute score prediction degrades under this shift, while rank-order prediction remains stable. Exploiting this asymmetry, we propose a simple optimization-free protocol: evaluate new agents only on tasks with intermediate historical pass rates (30-70%). This mid-range difficulty filter, motivated by Item Response Theory, reduces the number of evaluation tasks by 44-70% while maintaining high rank fidelity under scaffold and temporal shifts. It provides more reliable rankings than random sampling, which exhibits high variance across seeds, and outperforms greedy task selection under distribution shift. These results suggest that reliable leaderboard ranking does not require full-benchmark evaluation.

AI.tldr: 研究发现在AI智能体评估中，通过筛选中等难度任务（30-70%通过率）可以大幅减少评估成本（44-70%），同时保持排名准确性，比随机采样更可靠。
AI.motivation: 评估AI智能体在完整基准测试上成本高昂，因为每次评估都需要工具使用和多步推理的交互式展开。研究者希望探索是否可以通过小型任务子集以显著降低成本来保持智能体排名。
AI.method: 研究分析了8个基准测试、33个智能体框架和70多个模型配置，发现绝对分数预测在框架驱动的分布偏移下会退化，但排名顺序预测保持稳定。基于项目反应理论，提出了一个无需优化的简单协议：仅评估新智能体在历史通过率中等（30-70%）的任务上。
AI.result: 中等难度任务筛选方法将评估任务数量减少了44-70%，同时在框架和时间偏移下保持高排名保真度。比随机采样更可靠（随机采样在不同种子间方差高），在分布偏移下优于贪婪任务选择。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的排行榜排名不需要完整的基准测试评估。通过筛选中等难度任务可以大幅降低评估成本，同时保持排名准确性，这为AI智能体评估提供了高效实用的方法。

title: Prototype Fusion: A Training-Free Multi-Layer Approach to OOD Detection
summary: Deep learning models are increasingly deployed in safety-critical applications, where reliable out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is essential to ensure robustness. Existing methods predominantly rely on the penultimate-layer activations of neural networks, assuming they encapsulate the most informative in-distribution (ID) representations. In this work, we revisit this assumption to show that intermediate layers encode equally rich and discriminative information for OOD detection. Based on this observation, we propose a simple yet effective model-agnostic approach that leverages internal representations across multiple layers. Our scheme aggregates features from successive convolutional blocks, computes class-wise mean embeddings, and applies L_2 normalization to form compact ID prototypes capturing class semantics. During inference, cosine similarity between test features and these prototypes serves as an OOD score--ID samples exhibit strong affinity to at least one prototype, whereas OOD samples remain uniformly distant. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art OOD benchmarks across diverse architectures demonstrate that our approach delivers robust, architecture-agnostic performance and strong generalization for image classification. Notably, it improves AUROC by up to 4.41% and reduces FPR by 13.58%, highlighting multi-layer feature aggregation as a powerful yet underexplored signal for OOD detection, challenging the dominance of penultimate-layer-based methods. Our code is available at: https://github.com/sgchr273/cosine-layers.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用神经网络中间层特征进行OOD检测的新方法，通过聚合多层特征构建紧凑的原型表示，在推理时使用余弦相似度作为OOD分数，显著提升了检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有OOD检测方法主要依赖神经网络倒数第二层的激活，假设这些层包含最丰富的ID表示信息。本文重新审视这一假设，发现中间层同样编码了丰富且具有判别性的OOD检测信息。
AI.method: 提出了一种模型无关的方法：1）聚合连续卷积块的特征；2）计算类别的平均嵌入；3）应用L2归一化形成紧凑的ID原型；4）在推理时，使用测试特征与这些原型的余弦相似度作为OOD分数。
AI.result: 在多个最先进的OOD基准测试和不同架构上的广泛实验表明，该方法实现了稳健、架构无关的性能和强大的泛化能力。AUROC提升高达4.41%，FPR降低13.58%。
AI.conclusion: 多层特征聚合是OOD检测中强大但未被充分探索的信号，挑战了基于倒数第二层方法的统治地位。该方法为安全关键应用中的可靠OOD检测提供了新思路。

title: Cluster-R1: Large Reasoning Models Are Instruction-following Clustering Agents
summary: General-purpose embedding models excel at recognizing semantic similarities but fail to capture the characteristics of texts specified by user instructions. In contrast, instruction-tuned embedders can align embeddings with textual instructions yet cannot autonomously infer latent corpus structures, such as determining the optimal number of clusters. To address both limitations, we reframe instruction-following clustering as a generative task and train large reasoning models (LRMs) as autonomous clustering agents. Our reasoning-driven training pipeline enables LRMs to interpret high-level clustering instructions and then infer the corresponding latent groupings. To evaluate this paradigm, we introduce ReasonCluster, a comprehensive benchmark comprising 28 diverse tasks spanning daily dialogue, legal cases, and financial reports. Experiments across diverse datasets and clustering scenarios show that our approach consistently outperforms strong embedding-based methods and LRM baselines, demonstrating that explicit reasoning fosters more faithful and interpretable instruction-based clustering.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出将指令跟随聚类重构为生成任务，训练大型推理模型作为自主聚类代理，解决了通用嵌入模型无法捕获用户指令特征和指令调优嵌入器无法推断潜在语料结构的问题。
AI.motivation: 通用嵌入模型擅长识别语义相似性但无法捕获用户指令指定的文本特征，而指令调优嵌入器虽然能使嵌入与文本指令对齐，但无法自主推断潜在语料结构（如确定最佳聚类数量）。需要同时解决这两个限制。
AI.method: 将指令跟随聚类重构为生成任务，训练大型推理模型作为自主聚类代理。采用推理驱动的训练流程，使模型能够解释高级聚类指令并推断相应的潜在分组。
AI.result: 在包含28个多样化任务的ReasonCluster基准测试中，该方法在多种数据集和聚类场景下始终优于基于嵌入的方法和大型推理模型基线，表明显式推理能够促进更忠实和可解释的基于指令的聚类。
AI.conclusion: 通过将指令跟随聚类重构为生成任务并训练大型推理模型作为自主聚类代理，能够同时解决现有嵌入模型的局限性，实现更忠实和可解释的基于指令的聚类。

title: Learning-guided Prioritized Planning for Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding in Warehouse Automation
summary: Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) is critical for modern warehouse automation, which requires multiple robots to continuously navigate conflict-free paths to optimize the overall system throughput. However, the complexity of warehouse environments and the long-term dynamics of lifelong MAPF often demand costly adaptations to classical search-based solvers. While machine learning methods have been explored, their superiority over search-based methods remains inconclusive. In this paper, we introduce Reinforcement Learning (RL) guided Rolling Horizon Prioritized Planning (RL-RH-PP), the first framework integrating RL with search-based planning for lifelong MAPF. Specifically, we leverage classical Prioritized Planning (PP) as a backbone for its simplicity and flexibility in integrating with a learning-based priority assignment policy. By formulating dynamic priority assignment as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP), RL-RH-PP exploits the sequential decision-making nature of lifelong planning while delegating complex spatial-temporal interactions among agents to reinforcement learning. An attention-based neural network autoregressively decodes priority orders on-the-fly, enabling efficient sequential single-agent planning by the PP planner. Evaluations in realistic warehouse simulations show that RL-RH-PP achieves the highest total throughput among baselines and generalizes effectively across agent densities, planning horizons, and warehouse layouts. Our interpretive analyses reveal that RL-RH-PP proactively prioritizes congested agents and strategically redirects agents from congestion, easing traffic flow and boosting throughput. These findings highlight the potential of learning-guided approaches to augment traditional heuristics in modern warehouse automation.

AI.tldr: 提出RL-RH-PP框架，首次将强化学习与搜索规划结合用于终身多智能体路径规划，在仓库自动化中实现最高吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 终身多智能体路径规划对现代仓库自动化至关重要，但环境复杂性和长期动态性使传统搜索方法需要昂贵调整。机器学习方法虽有探索，但相对于搜索方法的优势仍不明确。
AI.method: 提出RL-RH-PP框架，以经典优先规划为骨干，将动态优先级分配建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程。使用基于注意力的神经网络自回归解码优先级顺序，实现高效的单智能体顺序规划。
AI.result: 在真实仓库模拟中，RL-RH-PP在所有基线方法中实现最高总吞吐量，并在智能体密度、规划视野和仓库布局方面表现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: RL-RH-PP通过主动优先处理拥堵智能体和战略性地重定向智能体来缓解交通流，提高吞吐量。这表明学习引导方法有潜力增强传统启发式方法在现代仓库自动化中的应用。

title: MoCHA: Denoising Caption Supervision for Motion-Text Retrieval
summary: Text-motion retrieval systems learn shared embedding spaces from motion-caption pairs via contrastive objectives. However, each caption is not a deterministic label but a sample from a distribution of valid descriptions: different annotators produce different text for the same motion, mixing motion-recoverable semantics (action type, body parts, directionality) with annotator-specific style and inferred context that cannot be determined from 3D joint coordinates alone. Standard contrastive training treats each caption as the single positive target, overlooking this distributional structure and inducing within-motion embedding variance that weakens alignment. We propose MoCHA, a text canonicalization framework that reduces this variance by projecting each caption onto its motion-recoverable content prior to encoding, producing tighter positive clusters and better-separated embeddings. Canonicalization is a general principle: even deterministic rule-based methods improve cross-dataset transfer, though learned canonicalizers provide substantially larger gains. We present two learned variants: an LLM-based approach (GPT-5.2) and a distilled FlanT5 model requiring no LLM at inference time. MoCHA operates as a preprocessing step compatible with any retrieval architecture. Applied to MoPa (MotionPatches), MoCHA sets a new state of the art on both HumanML3D (H) and KIT-ML (K): the LLM variant achieves 13.9% T2M R@1 on H (+3.1pp) and 24.3% on K (+10.3pp), while the LLM-free T5 variant achieves gains of +2.5pp and +8.1pp. Canonicalization reduces within-motion text-embedding variance by 11-19% and improves cross-dataset transfer substantially, with H to K improving by 94% and K to H by 52%, demonstrating that standardizing the language space yields more transferable motion-language representations.

AI.tldr: MoCHA提出文本规范化框架，通过将文本描述投影到仅从运动数据可恢复的语义内容上，减少文本-运动检索中的嵌入方差，提升对齐效果和跨数据集迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 在文本-运动检索中，同一动作的不同文本描述包含可恢复的语义（动作类型、身体部位、方向性）和不可恢复的注释者特定风格与推断上下文。标准对比学习将每个描述视为单一正样本，忽略了这种分布结构，导致嵌入方差增大，削弱了对齐效果。
AI.method: MoCHA是一个文本规范化框架，在编码前将每个文本描述投影到其运动可恢复的内容上。提出了两种学习变体：基于LLM的方法（GPT-5.2）和无需推理时LLM的蒸馏FlanT5模型。该方法作为预处理步骤，兼容任何检索架构。
AI.result: 在MoPa架构上应用MoCHA，在HumanML3D和KIT-ML数据集上达到新的SOTA：LLM变体在H上T2M R@1提升3.1pp至13.9%，在K上提升10.3pp至24.3%；T5变体分别提升2.5pp和8.1pp。文本嵌入方差减少11-19%，跨数据集迁移显著改善（H到K提升94%，K到H提升52%）。
AI.conclusion: 文本规范化通过标准化语言空间产生更具可迁移性的运动-语言表示，减少嵌入方差，提升检索性能。即使基于规则的规范化方法也能改善跨数据集迁移，但学习型规范化器提供更大增益。

title: VehicleMemBench: An Executable Benchmark for Multi-User Long-Term Memory in In-Vehicle Agents
summary: With the growing demand for intelligent in-vehicle experiences, vehicle-based agents are evolving from simple assistants to long-term companions. This evolution requires agents to continuously model multi-user preferences and make reliable decisions in the face of inter-user preference conflicts and changing habits over time. However, existing benchmarks are largely limited to single-user, static question-answer settings, failing to capture the temporal evolution of preferences and the multi-user, tool-interactive nature of real vehicle environments. To address this gap, we introduce VehicleMemBench, a multi-user long-context memory benchmark built on an executable in-vehicle simulation environment. The benchmark evaluates tool use and memory by comparing the post-action environment state with a predefined target state, enabling objective and reproducible evaluation without LLM-based or human scoring. VehicleMemBench includes 23 tool modules, and each sample contains over 80 historical memory events. Experiments show that powerful models perform well on direct instruction tasks but struggle in scenarios involving memory evolution, particularly when user preferences change dynamically. Even advanced memory systems struggle to handle domain-specific memory requirements in this environment. These findings highlight the need for more robust and specialized memory management mechanisms to support long-term adaptive decision-making in real-world in-vehicle systems. To facilitate future research, we release the data and code.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了VehicleMemBench，一个用于评估车载多用户长期记忆系统的基准测试，解决了现有基准在动态偏好建模和多用户交互方面的不足。
AI.motivation: 随着车载智能体验需求增长，车载代理正从简单助手演变为长期伴侣，需要持续建模多用户偏好并处理用户间偏好冲突和随时间变化的习惯。现有基准主要局限于单用户、静态问答设置，无法捕捉真实车载环境中偏好的时间演化和多用户工具交互特性。
AI.method: 引入VehicleMemBench，一个基于可执行车载仿真环境构建的多用户长上下文记忆基准。该基准通过比较行动后环境状态与预定义目标状态来评估工具使用和记忆，无需基于LLM或人工评分，实现了客观可重复的评估。包含23个工具模块，每个样本包含超过80个历史记忆事件。
AI.result: 实验表明，强大模型在直接指令任务上表现良好，但在涉及记忆演化的场景中表现不佳，特别是当用户偏好动态变化时。即使是先进的记忆系统也难以处理该环境中的领域特定记忆需求。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调了需要更鲁棒和专门的记忆管理机制来支持现实世界车载系统中的长期自适应决策。为促进未来研究，作者发布了数据和代码。

title: AdvSplat: Adversarial Attacks on Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting Models
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is increasingly recognized as a powerful paradigm for real-time, high-fidelity 3D reconstruction. However, its per-scene optimization pipeline limits scalability and generalization, and prevents efficient inference. Recently emerged feed-forward 3DGS models address these limitations by enabling fast reconstruction from a few input views after large-scale pretraining, without scene-specific optimization. Despite their advantages and strong potential for commercial deployment, the use of neural networks as the backbone also amplifies the risk of adversarial manipulation. In this paper, we introduce AdvSplat, the first systematic study of adversarial attacks on feed-forward 3DGS. We first employ white-box attacks to reveal fundamental vulnerabilities of this model family. We then develop two improved, practically relevant, query-efficient black-box algorithms that optimize pixel-space perturbations via a frequency-domain parameterization: one based on gradient estimation and the other gradient-free, without requiring any access to model internals. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that AdvSplat can significantly disrupt reconstruction results by injecting imperceptible perturbations into the input images. Our findings surface an overlooked yet urgent problem in this domain, and we hope to draw the community's attention to this emerging security and robustness challenge.

AI.tldr: AdvSplat是首个针对前馈式3D高斯泼溅模型的对抗攻击系统研究，揭示了该模型家族的脆弱性，并开发了两种实用的查询高效黑盒攻击算法。
AI.motivation: 前馈式3DGS模型虽然解决了传统3DGS在可扩展性、泛化性和推理效率方面的限制，但其基于神经网络的架构增加了对抗性操纵的风险。目前缺乏对该模型家族安全性和鲁棒性的系统性研究。
AI.method: 首先使用白盒攻击揭示模型的基本脆弱性，然后开发了两种改进的、查询高效的黑盒攻击算法：一种基于梯度估计，另一种是无梯度的。两种方法都通过频域参数化优化像素空间扰动，无需访问模型内部。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的广泛实验表明，AdvSplat能够通过向输入图像注入难以察觉的扰动，显著破坏3D重建结果，证明了前馈式3DGS模型存在严重的安全漏洞。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了3DGS领域一个被忽视但紧迫的安全和鲁棒性问题，希望引起社区对这一新兴安全挑战的关注，为未来开发更鲁棒的3D重建模型提供基础。

title: SCoOP: Semantic Consistent Opinion Pooling for Uncertainty Quantification in Multiple Vision-Language Model Systems
comment: Accepted to ICLR 2024 Workshop on Agentic AI in the Wild: From Hallucinations to Reliable Autonomy
summary: Combining multiple Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can enhance multimodal reasoning and robustness, but aggregating heterogeneous models' outputs amplifies uncertainty and increases the risk of hallucinations. We propose SCoOP (Semantic-Consistent Opinion Pooling), a training-free uncertainty quantification (UQ) framework multi-VLM systems through uncertainty-weighted linear opinion pooling. Unlike prior UQ methods designed for single models, SCoOP explicitly measures collective, system-level uncertainty across multiple VLMs, enabling effective hallucination detection and abstention for highly uncertain samples. On ScienceQA, SCoOP achieves an AUROC of 0.866 for hallucination detection, outperforming baselines (0.732-0.757) by approximately 10-13%. For abstention, it attains an AURAC of 0.907, exceeding baselines (0.818-0.840) by 7-9%. Despite these gains, SCoOP introduces only microsecond-level aggregation overhead relative to the baselines, which is trivial compared to typical VLM inference time (on the order of seconds). These results demonstrate that SCoOP provides an efficient and principled mechanism for uncertainty-aware aggregation, advancing the reliability of multimodal AI systems.

AI.tldr: SCoOP是一个无需训练的框架，通过语义一致的意见池化来量化多视觉语言模型系统中的不确定性，有效检测幻觉并实现不确定性感知的聚合。
AI.motivation: 结合多个视觉语言模型可以增强多模态推理和鲁棒性，但聚合异构模型的输出会放大不确定性并增加幻觉风险。现有不确定性量化方法主要针对单一模型，缺乏对多模型系统级不确定性的测量。
AI.method: 提出SCoOP（语义一致的意见池化），这是一个无需训练的不确定性量化框架，通过不确定性加权的线性意见池化来处理多视觉语言模型系统。该方法明确测量多个VLMs之间的集体、系统级不确定性。
AI.result: 在ScienceQA数据集上，SCoOP在幻觉检测方面达到0.866的AUROC，比基线方法（0.732-0.757）高出约10-13%；在弃权方面达到0.907的AURAC，比基线（0.818-0.840）高出7-9%。同时仅引入微秒级的聚合开销。
AI.conclusion: SCoOP为不确定性感知聚合提供了一个高效且原则性的机制，显著提升了多模态AI系统的可靠性，同时保持了计算效率。

title: Chitrakshara: A Large Multilingual Multimodal Dataset for Indian languages
comment: Accepted at "CVPR 2025: Workshop Vision Language Models For All"
summary: Multimodal research has predominantly focused on single-image reasoning, with limited exploration of multi-image scenarios. Recent models have sought to enhance multi-image understanding through large-scale pretraining on interleaved image-text datasets. However, most Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are trained primarily on English datasets, leading to inadequate representation of Indian languages. To address this gap, we introduce the Chitrakshara dataset series, covering 11 Indian languages sourced from Common Crawl. It comprises (1) Chitrakshara-IL, a large-scale interleaved pretraining dataset with 193M images, 30B text tokens, and 50M multilingual documents, and (2) Chitrakshara-Cap, which includes 44M image-text pairs with 733M tokens. This paper details the data collection pipeline, including curation, filtering, and processing methodologies. Additionally, we present a comprehensive quality and diversity analysis to assess the dataset's representativeness across Indic languages and its potential for developing more culturally inclusive VLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了Chitrakshara数据集系列，包含两个大规模多模态数据集，专门针对11种印度语言，旨在解决当前视觉语言模型在印度语言表示不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态研究主要集中在单图像推理，多图像场景探索有限。现有视觉语言模型主要在英语数据集上训练，导致对印度语言的表示不足，需要专门针对印度语言的大规模多模态数据集。
AI.method: 从Common Crawl收集数据，构建了两个数据集：Chitrakshara-IL（大规模交错预训练数据集，包含1.93亿图像、300亿文本标记和5000万多语言文档）和Chitrakshara-Cap（4400万图像-文本对，包含73.3亿标记）。详细描述了数据收集、筛选和处理流程。
AI.result: 创建了覆盖11种印度语言的大规模多模态数据集，包含大量图像和文本资源。通过全面的质量和多样性分析，评估了数据集在印度语言中的代表性。
AI.conclusion: Chitrakshara数据集系列填补了印度语言多模态数据的空白，为开发更具文化包容性的视觉语言模型提供了重要资源，有助于促进多语言和多文化的人工智能发展。

title: When AI output tips to bad but nobody notices: Legal implications of AI's mistakes
summary: The adoption of generative AI across commercial and legal professions offers dramatic efficiency gains -- yet for law in particular, it introduces a perilous failure mode in which the AI fabricates fictitious case law, statutes, and judicial holdings that appear entirely authentic. Attorneys who unknowingly file such fabrications face professional sanctions, malpractice exposure, and reputational harm, while courts confront a novel threat to the integrity of the adversarial process. This failure mode is commonly dismissed as random `hallucination', but recent physics-based analysis of the Transformer's core mechanism reveals a deterministic component: the AI's internal state can cross a calculable threshold, causing its output to flip from reliable legal reasoning to authoritative-sounding fabrication. Here we present this science in a legal-industry setting, walking through a simulated brief-drafting scenario. Our analysis suggests that fabrication risk is not an anomalous glitch but a foreseeable consequence of the technology's design, with direct implications for the evolving duty of technological competence. We propose that legal professionals, courts, and regulators replace the outdated `black box' mental model with verification protocols based on how these systems actually fail.

AI.tldr: 论文分析了生成式AI在法律行业应用中的危险失效模式：AI会伪造看似真实的判例、法规和司法观点，这对律师和司法系统构成严重威胁。研究发现这种伪造不是随机的"幻觉"，而是Transformer机制中可计算的确定性现象。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在商业和法律领域的应用带来了显著的效率提升，但同时也引入了危险的失效模式——AI会伪造看似完全真实的判例、法规和司法观点。律师如果无意中提交这些伪造内容，将面临职业制裁、渎职责任和声誉损害，而法院则面临对抗制程序完整性的新威胁。
AI.method: 基于最近对Transformer核心机制的物理分析，揭示了AI内部状态存在可计算的阈值，当超过该阈值时，输出会从可靠的法律推理翻转为权威性的伪造内容。论文通过模拟案情摘要起草场景来展示这一科学原理。
AI.result: 分析表明，伪造风险不是异常故障，而是技术设计的可预见后果，对技术能力义务的演变有直接影响。研究建议用基于系统实际失效方式的验证协议取代过时的"黑箱"思维模式。
AI.conclusion: 法律专业人士、法院和监管机构需要放弃过时的"黑箱"思维模式，转而采用基于这些系统实际失效方式的验证协议，以应对生成式AI带来的伪造风险，这已成为技术能力义务的重要组成部分。

title: Qworld: Question-Specific Evaluation Criteria for LLMs
summary: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) on open-ended questions is difficult because response quality depends on the question's context. Binary scores and static rubrics fail to capture these context-dependent requirements. Existing methods define criteria at the dataset level or generate them in a single pass, which limits their ability to explore the evaluation space implied by each question. We introduce One-Question-One-World (Qworld), a method that generates question-specific evaluation criteria using a recursive expansion tree. Given a question, Qworld decomposes it into scenarios, perspectives, and fine-grained binary criteria through structured hierarchical and horizontal expansion. The resulting criteria specify what a high-quality answer must address for that question. On HealthBench, Qworld covers 89% of expert-authored criteria and generates 79% novel criteria validated by human experts. Experts rate Qworld criteria higher in insight and granularity than those produced by prior methods. When applied to 11 frontier LLMs on HealthBench and Humanity's Last Exam, Qworld reveals capability differences in dimensions such as long-term impact, equity, error handling, and interdisciplinary reasoning that coarse rubrics do not distinguish. By formulating criteria generation as structured coverage of question-implied evaluation axes, Qworld enables evaluation that adapts to each question rather than relying on fixed task-level criteria.

AI.tldr: Qworld是一种为开放式问题生成特定评估标准的方法，通过递归扩展树创建问题相关的评估维度，相比传统静态评分标准能更全面地捕捉上下文依赖的质量要求。
AI.motivation: 现有评估大语言模型的方法存在局限性：二元评分和静态评分标准无法捕捉开放式问题的上下文依赖要求；现有方法在数据集层面定义标准或单次生成标准，限制了探索每个问题隐含的评估空间的能力。
AI.method: Qworld采用递归扩展树方法，针对每个问题生成特定的评估标准。通过结构化分层和水平扩展，将问题分解为场景、视角和细粒度的二元标准，从而明确高质量回答必须涵盖的内容。
AI.result: 在HealthBench上，Qworld覆盖了89%的专家编写标准，并生成了79%经人类专家验证的新标准。专家认为Qworld标准在洞察力和粒度方面优于先前方法。应用于11个前沿LLM时，Qworld揭示了在长期影响、公平性、错误处理和跨学科推理等维度上的能力差异，这些是粗粒度标准无法区分的。
AI.conclusion: 通过将标准生成构建为结构化覆盖问题隐含评估轴的方法，Qworld实现了适应每个问题的评估，而不是依赖固定的任务级标准，为开放式问题的评估提供了更灵活和全面的框架。

title: The DeepXube Software Package for Solving Pathfinding Problems with Learned Heuristic Functions and Search
summary: DeepXube is a free and open-source Python package and command-line tool that seeks to automate the solution of pathfinding problems by using machine learning to learn heuristic functions that guide heuristic search algorithms tailored to deep neural networks (DNNs). DeepXube is comprised of the latest advances in deep reinforcement learning, heuristic search, and formal logic for solving pathfinding problems. This includes limited-horizon Bellman-based learning, hindsight experience replay, batched heuristic search, and specifying goals with answer-set programming. A robust multiple-inheritance structure simplifies the definition of pathfinding domains and the generation of training data. Training heuristic functions is made efficient through the automatic parallelization of the generation of training data across central processing units (CPUs) and reinforcement learning updates across graphics processing units (GPUs). Pathfinding algorithms that take advantage of the parallelism of GPUs and DNN architectures, such as batch weighted A* and Q* search and beam search are easily employed to solve pathfinding problems through command-line arguments. Finally, several convenient features for visualization, code profiling, and progress monitoring during training and solving are available. The GitHub repository is publicly available at https://github.com/forestagostinelli/deepxube.

AI.tldr: DeepXube是一个开源Python包和命令行工具，使用机器学习学习启发式函数来指导针对深度神经网络的启发式搜索算法，自动化解决路径规划问题。
AI.motivation: 开发一个自动化解决路径规划问题的工具，结合机器学习、启发式搜索和形式逻辑的最新进展，简化路径规划领域的定义和训练数据生成。
AI.method: 采用有限视野贝尔曼学习、后见经验回放、批量启发式搜索和答案集编程指定目标。通过多重继承结构简化领域定义，自动并行化CPU上的训练数据生成和GPU上的强化学习更新，利用批量加权A*、Q*搜索和波束搜索等算法。
AI.result: 开发了一个功能完整的开源工具，提供可视化、代码分析和训练进度监控等便利功能，GitHub仓库已公开。
AI.conclusion: DeepXube成功整合了深度强化学习、启发式搜索和形式逻辑技术，为路径规划问题提供了一个高效、可扩展的自动化解决方案框架。

title: Do 3D Large Language Models Really Understand 3D Spatial Relationships?
summary: Recent 3D Large-Language Models (3D-LLMs) claim to understand 3D worlds, especially spatial relationships among objects. Yet, we find that simply fine-tuning a language model on text-only question-answer pairs can perform comparably or even surpass these methods on the SQA3D benchmark without using any 3D input. This indicates that the SQA3D benchmark may not be able to detect if the model exploits textual shortcuts rather than engages in 3D-aware reasoning. To address this issue, we introduce Real-3DQA, a more rigorous evaluation benchmark that filters out easy-to-guess questions and introduces a structured taxonomy to assess various aspects of 3D reasoning. Experiments on Real-3DQA confirm that existing 3D-LLMs struggle with spatial relationships once simple cues are removed. We further propose a 3D-reweighted training objective that guides model to rely more on 3D visual clues, substantially enhancing 3D-LLMs performance in spatial reasoning tasks. Our findings underscore the need for robust benchmarks and tailored training strategies to advance genuine 3D vision-language understanding. Project page: https://real-3dqa.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 研究发现现有3D-LLMs在SQA3D基准上可能依赖文本捷径而非真正的3D推理，提出了更严格的Real-3DQA基准和3D重加权训练目标来提升空间推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有3D大语言模型声称能理解3D世界，但研究发现仅用文本问答微调的语言模型在SQA3D基准上表现相当甚至更好，表明该基准可能无法检测模型是否利用文本捷径而非真正的3D感知推理。
AI.method: 1) 提出Real-3DQA基准，过滤易猜测问题并引入结构化分类来评估3D推理的各个方面；2) 提出3D重加权训练目标，引导模型更多依赖3D视觉线索。
AI.result: 实验证实现有3D-LLMs在简单线索被移除后难以处理空间关系；提出的3D重加权训练目标显著提升了3D-LLMs在空间推理任务上的性能。
AI.conclusion: 需要更鲁棒的基准测试和定制化的训练策略来推进真正的3D视觉语言理解，Real-3DQA基准和3D重加权训练为此提供了有效解决方案。

title: DUPLEX: Agentic Dual-System Planning via LLM-Driven Information Extraction
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) provide semantic flexibility for robotic task planning, their susceptibility to hallucination and logical inconsistency limits their reliability in long-horizon domains. To bridge the gap between unstructured environments and rigorous plan synthesis, we propose DUPLEX, an agentic dual-system neuro-symbolic architecture that strictly confines the LLM to schema-guided information extraction rather than end-to-end planning or code generation. In our framework, a feed-forward Fast System utilizes a lightweight LLM to extract entities, relations etc. from natural language, deterministically mapping them into a Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) problem file for a classical symbolic planner. To resolve complex or underspecified scenarios, a Slow System is activated exclusively upon planning failure, leveraging solver diagnostics to drive a high-capacity LLM in iterative reflection and repair. Extensive evaluations across 12 classical and household planning domains demonstrate that DUPLEX significantly outperforms existing end-to-end and hybrid LLM baselines in both success rate and reliability. These results confirm that The key is not to make the LLM plan better, but to restrict the LLM to the part it is good at - structured semantic grounding - and leave logical plan synthesis to a symbolic planner.

AI.tldr: DUPLEX：一种双系统神经符号架构，通过将LLM严格限制在模式引导的信息提取而非端到端规划，结合经典符号规划器，显著提升长时域任务规划的可靠性和成功率。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在机器人任务规划中具有语义灵活性，但其幻觉和逻辑不一致问题限制了在长时域领域的可靠性。需要弥合非结构化环境与严格规划综合之间的差距。
AI.method: 提出DUPLEX双系统神经符号架构：快速系统使用轻量级LLM从自然语言中提取实体、关系等，确定性地映射到PDDL问题文件供经典符号规划器使用；慢速系统仅在规划失败时激活，利用求解器诊断驱动高容量LLM进行迭代反思和修复。
AI.result: 在12个经典和家庭规划领域的广泛评估表明，DUPLEX在成功率和可靠性方面显著优于现有的端到端和混合LLM基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 关键不是让LLM规划得更好，而是将其限制在擅长的部分——结构化语义基础——而将逻辑规划综合留给符号规划器。

title: Navigating the Concept Space of Language Models
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) trained on large language model activations output thousands of features that enable mapping to human-interpretable concepts. The current practice for analyzing these features primarily relies on inspecting top-activating examples, manually browsing individual features, or performing semantic search on interested concepts, which makes exploratory discovery of concepts difficult at scale. In this paper, we present Concept Explorer, a scalable interactive system for post-hoc exploration of SAE features that organizes concept explanations using hierarchical neighborhood embeddings. Our approach constructs a multi-resolution manifold over SAE feature embeddings and enables progressive navigation from coarse concept clusters to fine-grained neighborhoods, supporting discovery, comparison, and relationship analysis among concepts. We demonstrate the utility of Concept Explorer on SAE features extracted from SmolLM2, where it reveals coherent high-level structure, meaningful subclusters, and distinctive rare concepts that are hard to identify with existing workflows.

AI.tldr: 提出了Concept Explorer系统，用于大规模交互式探索稀疏自编码器特征，通过分层邻域嵌入组织概念解释，支持从粗粒度概念簇到细粒度邻域的渐进导航。
AI.motivation: 当前分析稀疏自编码器特征的方法主要依赖检查激活示例、手动浏览单个特征或对感兴趣概念进行语义搜索，这使得大规模探索性概念发现变得困难。
AI.method: 构建了基于SAE特征嵌入的多分辨率流形，使用分层邻域嵌入组织概念解释，支持渐进式导航从粗粒度概念簇到细粒度邻域。
AI.result: 在SmolLM2提取的SAE特征上展示了Concept Explorer的实用性，揭示了连贯的高层结构、有意义的子簇以及难以用现有工作流识别的独特稀有概念。
AI.conclusion: Concept Explorer为SAE特征的后验探索提供了可扩展的交互式系统，能够有效支持概念的发现、比较和关系分析。

title: AnalogAgent: Self-Improving Analog Circuit Design Automation with LLM Agents
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) suggest strong potential for automating analog circuit design. Yet most LLM-based approaches rely on a single-model loop of generation, diagnosis, and correction, which favors succinct summaries over domain-specific insight and suffers from context attrition that erases critical technical details. To address these limitations, we propose AnalogAgent, a training-free agentic framework that integrates an LLM-based multi-agent system (MAS) with self-evolving memory (SEM) for analog circuit design automation. AnalogAgent coordinates a Code Generator, Design Optimizer, and Knowledge Curator to distill execution feedback into an adaptive playbook in SEM and retrieve targeted guidance for subsequent generation, enabling cross-task transfer without additional expert feedback, databases, or libraries. Across established benchmarks, AnalogAgent achieves 92% Pass@1 with Gemini and 97.4% Pass@1 with GPT-5. Moreover, with compact models (e.g., Qwen-8B), it yields a +48.8% average Pass@1 gain across tasks and reaches 72.1% Pass@1 overall, indicating that AnalogAgent substantially strengthens open-weight models for high-quality analog circuit design automation.

AI.tldr: AnalogAgent是一个无需训练的智能体框架，通过多智能体系统和自演化记忆实现模拟电路设计自动化，显著提升LLM在电路设计任务中的性能。
AI.motivation: 当前基于LLM的模拟电路设计方法存在两个主要问题：1）依赖单一模型的生成-诊断-修正循环，偏向简洁总结而非领域特定洞察；2）存在上下文衰减问题，会擦除关键技术细节。需要一种能保留技术细节并实现跨任务知识转移的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出AnalogAgent框架，整合LLM多智能体系统（MAS）和自演化记忆（SEM）。框架包含三个智能体：代码生成器、设计优化器和知识策展人，它们将执行反馈提炼成自适应操作手册存储在SEM中，并为后续生成检索针对性指导。
AI.result: 在标准基准测试中，AnalogAgent使用Gemini达到92% Pass@1，使用GPT-5达到97.4% Pass@1。对于紧凑模型（如Qwen-8B），平均Pass@1提升48.8%，总体达到72.1% Pass@1，显著增强了开源模型在模拟电路设计自动化中的能力。
AI.conclusion: AnalogAgent通过多智能体协作和自演化记忆机制，有效解决了现有LLM方法在模拟电路设计中的局限性，无需额外专家反馈、数据库或库就能实现跨任务知识转移，大幅提升了电路设计自动化的质量和效率。

title: Detection and Classification of (Pre)Cancerous Cells in Pap Smears: An Ensemble Strategy for the RIVA Cervical Cytology Challenge
comment: Accepted for Poster Presentation at the RIVA Cervical Cytology Challenge, IEEE ISBI 2026. 4 pages, 2 figures
summary: Automated detection and classification of cervical cells in conventional Pap smear images can strengthen cervical cancer screening at scale by reducing manual workload, improving triage, and increasing consistency across readers. However, it is challenged by severe class imbalance and frequent nuclear overlap. We present our approach to the RIVA Cervical Cytology Challenge (ISBI 2026), which requires multi-class detection of eight Bethesda cell categories under these conditions. Using YOLOv11m as the base architecture, we systematically evaluate three strategies to improve detection performance: loss reweighting, data resampling and transfer learning. We build an ensemble by combining models trained under each strategy, promoting complementary detection behavior and combining them through Weighted Boxes Fusion (WBF). The ensemble achieves a mAP50-95 of 0.201 on the preliminary test set and 0.147 on the final test set, representing a 29% improvement over the best individual model on the final test set and demonstrating the effectiveness of combining complementary imbalance mitigation strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于YOLOv11m的宫颈细胞检测方法，通过集成学习结合损失重加权、数据重采样和迁移学习三种策略，在ISBI 2026 RIVA宫颈细胞学挑战中显著提升了检测性能。
AI.motivation: 传统巴氏涂片图像中宫颈细胞的自动检测和分类可以大规模加强宫颈癌筛查，减少人工工作量，改善分流，提高不同阅片者间的一致性。但面临严重的类别不平衡和频繁的细胞核重叠等挑战。
AI.method: 使用YOLOv11m作为基础架构，系统评估三种策略：损失重加权、数据重采样和迁移学习。通过集成学习将每种策略训练的模型组合，利用加权框融合（WBF）促进互补检测行为。
AI.result: 集成模型在初步测试集上达到mAP50-95为0.201，在最终测试集上为0.147，相比最佳个体模型在最终测试集上提升了29%，证明了结合互补不平衡缓解策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过集成多种不平衡缓解策略，显著提升了宫颈细胞检测性能，为大规模宫颈癌筛查提供了有效的自动化解决方案。

title: Prompt Compression in Production Task Orchestration: A Pre-Registered Randomized Trial
comment: 28 pages, 9 tables, 1 CONSORT figure; pre-registered randomized controlled trial on production orchestration prompts
summary: The economics of prompt compression depend not only on reducing input tokens but on how compression changes output length, which is typically priced several times higher. We evaluate this in a pre-registered six-arm randomized controlled trial of prompt compression on production multi-agent task-orchestration, analyzing 358 successful Claude Sonnet 4.5 runs (59-61 per arm) drawn from a randomized corpus of 1,199 real orchestration instructions. We compare an uncompressed control with three uniform retention rates (r=0.8, 0.5, 0.2) and two structure-aware strategies (entropy-adaptive and recency-weighted), measuring total inference cost (input+output) and embedding-based response similarity. Moderate compression (r=0.5) reduced mean total cost by 27.9%, while aggressive compression (r=0.2) increased mean cost by 1.8% despite substantial input reduction, consistent with small mean output expansion (1.03x vs. control) and heavy-tailed uncertainty. Recency-weighted compression achieved 23.5% savings and, together with moderate compression, occupied the empirical cost-similarity Pareto frontier, whereas aggressive compression was dominated on both cost and similarity. These results show that "compress more" is not a reliable production heuristic and that output tokens must be treated as a first-class outcome when designing compression policies.

AI.tldr: 提示压缩的经济效益不仅取决于减少输入token，还取决于压缩如何改变输出长度，而输出token通常定价更高。研究发现适度压缩(r=0.5)可降低总成本27.9%，但激进压缩(r=0.2)反而增加成本1.8%，表明"压缩越多越好"并非可靠的生产启发式方法。
AI.motivation: 研究提示压缩的经济效益，特别是压缩如何影响输出长度，因为输出token通常比输入token定价更高。需要理解不同压缩策略在真实生产环境中的实际效果，以制定有效的压缩策略。
AI.method: 采用预注册的六臂随机对照试验，在真实的多智能体任务编排生产环境中测试提示压缩。比较无压缩对照组、三种均匀保留率(r=0.8, 0.5, 0.2)和两种结构感知策略（熵自适应和最近加权），分析358次成功的Claude Sonnet 4.5运行。
AI.result: 适度压缩(r=0.5)平均降低总成本27.9%；激进压缩(r=0.2)尽管大幅减少输入，但平均成本增加1.8%，输出略有扩张(1.03倍)。最近加权压缩节省23.5%成本，与适度压缩一起占据成本-相似性帕累托前沿，而激进压缩在成本和相似性上均被支配。
AI.conclusion: "压缩越多越好"不是可靠的生产启发式方法，设计压缩策略时必须将输出token作为首要考虑因素。适度压缩和结构感知策略（如最近加权）在保持响应相似性的同时能有效降低成本。

title: From Pixels to Digital Agents: An Empirical Study on the Taxonomy and Technological Trends of Reinforcement Learning Environments
summary: The remarkable progress of reinforcement learning (RL) is intrinsically tied to the environments used to train and evaluate artificial agents. Moving beyond traditional qualitative reviews, this work presents a large-scale, data-driven empirical investigation into the evolution of RL environments. By programmatically processing a massive corpus of academic literature and rigorously distilling over 2,000 core publications, we propose a quantitative methodology to map the transition from isolated physical simulations to generalist, language-driven foundation agents. Implementing a novel, multi-dimensional taxonomy, we systematically analyze benchmarks against diverse application domains and requisite cognitive capabilities. Our automated semantic and statistical analysis reveals a profound, data-verified paradigm shift: the bifurcation of the field into a "Semantic Prior" ecosystem dominated by Large Language Models (LLMs) and a "Domain-Specific Generalization" ecosystem. Furthermore, we characterize the "cognitive fingerprints" of these distinct domains to uncover the underlying mechanisms of cross-task synergy, multi-domain interference, and zero-shot generalization. Ultimately, this study offers a rigorous, quantitative roadmap for designing the next generation of Embodied Semantic Simulators, bridging the gap between continuous physical control and high-level logical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模数据驱动方法，定量分析了强化学习环境从物理模拟到语言驱动基础智能体的演变过程，揭示了领域向"语义先验"和"领域特定泛化"两大生态系统的分化。
AI.motivation: 强化学习的进展与环境密切相关，但现有研究多为定性回顾。本文旨在通过大规模、数据驱动的实证研究，量化分析RL环境的演变历程，超越传统定性综述。
AI.method: 通过程序化处理大量学术文献，从2000多篇核心出版物中提取数据，采用新颖的多维度分类法，系统分析基准测试在不同应用领域和认知能力要求上的表现，进行自动化的语义和统计分析。
AI.result: 分析揭示了一个深刻的范式转变：领域分化为由大语言模型主导的"语义先验"生态系统和"领域特定泛化"生态系统。研究还刻画了这些不同领域的"认知指纹"，揭示了跨任务协同、多领域干扰和零样本泛化的底层机制。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为设计下一代具身语义模拟器提供了严谨的定量路线图，弥合了连续物理控制与高层逻辑推理之间的鸿沟。

title: IJmond Industrial Smoke Segmentation Dataset
summary: This report describes a dataset for industrial smoke segmentation, published on a figshare repository (https://doi.org/10.21942/uva.31847188). The dataset is licensed under CC BY 4.0.

AI.tldr: 该论文发布了一个工业烟雾分割数据集，包含图像和标注，可用于计算机视觉研究
AI.motivation: 为工业烟雾检测和分割研究提供标准化的数据集，促进相关算法的发展
AI.method: 创建并发布工业烟雾分割数据集，包含图像数据和相应的分割标注
AI.result: 在figshare上发布了完整的数据集，采用CC BY 4.0许可协议，可通过指定DOI访问
AI.conclusion: 该数据集为工业烟雾分割研究提供了有价值的资源，有助于推动相关计算机视觉技术的发展

title: Plato's Cave: A Human-Centered Research Verification System
summary: The growing publication rate of research papers has created an urgent need for better ways to fact-check information, assess writing quality, and identify unverifiable claims. We present Plato's Cave as an open-source, human-centered research verification system that (i) creates a directed acyclic graph (DAG) from a document, (ii) leverages web agents to assign credibility scores to nodes and edges from the DAG, and (iii) gives a final score by interpreting and evaluating the paper's argumentative structure. We report the system implementation and results on a collected dataset of 104 research papers.

AI.tldr: Plato's Cave是一个开源的人类中心研究验证系统，通过构建文档的有向无环图，利用网络代理为节点和边分配可信度分数，最终通过解释和评估论文的论证结构给出最终评分。
AI.motivation: 研究论文发表率的快速增长迫切需要更好的方法来事实核查信息、评估写作质量和识别不可验证的声明。
AI.method: 系统(i)从文档创建有向无环图(DAG)，(ii)利用网络代理为DAG中的节点和边分配可信度分数，(iii)通过解释和评估论文的论证结构给出最终评分。
AI.result: 报告了系统实现和在收集的104篇研究论文数据集上的结果。
AI.conclusion: Plato's Cave是一个有效的研究验证系统，能够帮助应对研究论文快速增长带来的信息验证挑战。

title: Language-Grounded Multi-Agent Planning for Personalized and Fair Participatory Urban Sensing
summary: Participatory urban sensing leverages human mobility for large-scale urban data collection, yet existing methods typically rely on centralized optimization and assume homogeneous participants, resulting in rigid assignments that overlook personal preferences and heterogeneous urban contexts. We propose MAPUS, an LLM-based multi-agent framework for personalized and fair participatory urban sensing. In our framework, participants are modeled as autonomous agents with individual profiles and schedules, while a coordinator agent performs fairness-aware selection and refines sensing routes through language-based negotiation. Experiments on real-world datasets show that MAPUS achieves competitive sensing coverage while substantially improving participant satisfaction and fairness, promoting more human-centric and sustainable urban sensing systems.

AI.tldr: MAPUS是一个基于大语言模型的多智能体框架，用于实现个性化和公平的参与式城市感知，通过语言协商机制平衡参与者偏好与感知任务需求。
AI.motivation: 现有参与式城市感知方法通常依赖集中式优化，假设参与者同质化，导致任务分配僵化，忽视了个人偏好和城市环境的异质性，需要更人性化和可持续的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出MAPUS框架：将参与者建模为具有个人档案和日程的自主智能体，协调器智能体执行公平感知的选择，并通过基于语言的协商机制优化感知路线。
AI.result: 在真实世界数据集上的实验表明，MAPUS在保持竞争力的感知覆盖率的同时，显著提高了参与者满意度和公平性。
AI.conclusion: MAPUS促进了更以人为本和可持续的城市感知系统，通过多智能体协商机制平衡了系统效率与参与者偏好。

title: Compression Method Matters: Benchmark-Dependent Output Dynamics in LLM Prompt Compression
comment: 19 pages. Includes figures and tables. Companion code/data repository and direct NVML calibration dataset are cited in manuscript
summary: Prompt compression is often evaluated by input-token reduction, but its real deployment impact depends on how compression changes output length and total inference cost. We present a controlled replication and extension study of benchmark-dependent output dynamics under aggressive compression, covering 5,400 API calls across three benchmarks and multiple providers. To explain conflicting prior observations, we formalize instruction survival probability (Psi), a structural metric that captures whether task-critical prompt segments remain after truncation. Results show a strong benchmark effect: under r=0.3, DeepSeek exhibits severe output expansion on MBPP (56x, Psi approx 0.15) but substantially lower expansion on HumanEval (5x, Psi approx 0.72), while GPT-4o-mini is comparatively stable across benchmarks. This reconciles the apparent discrepancy between previously reported extreme explosion and lower replication effects by identifying prompt structure, not provider identity alone, as the primary moderator. We introduce the Compression Robustness Index (CRI) for cross-benchmark evaluation and show that single-benchmark assessments can produce misleading conclusions about compression safety and efficiency. To contextualize energy claims, we incorporate companion direct NVML measurements from rented RunPod GPUs and show that token savings can overstate joule savings. These findings motivate benchmark-diverse testing and structure-aware compression policies for reliable, energy-conscious LLM deployment.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了提示压缩对输出长度和总推理成本的实际影响，发现基准测试的选择会显著影响结果，并提出了指令生存概率和压缩鲁棒性指数来评估压缩效果。
AI.motivation: 当前提示压缩评估主要关注输入token减少，但实际部署影响取决于压缩如何改变输出长度和总推理成本。先前研究存在矛盾观察，需要解释这些差异并建立更全面的评估框架。
AI.method: 进行了受控复制和扩展研究，涵盖5,400个API调用，涉及三个基准测试和多个提供商。提出了指令生存概率（Psi）作为结构度量，并引入压缩鲁棒性指数（CRI）进行跨基准评估。同时结合了NVML直接测量来评估能耗。
AI.result: 发现强烈的基准效应：在r=0.3压缩率下，DeepSeek在MBPP上表现出严重输出扩展（56倍，Psi约0.15），但在HumanEval上扩展较低（5倍，Psi约0.72）。GPT-4o-mini在不同基准间相对稳定。单基准评估可能产生误导性结论，token节省可能高估实际能耗节省。
AI.conclusion: 提示结构而非提供商身份是压缩效果的主要调节因素。需要基准多样化的测试和结构感知的压缩策略，以实现可靠且节能的LLM部署。压缩鲁棒性指数提供了更全面的评估框架。

title: ELITE: Experiential Learning and Intent-Aware Transfer for Self-improving Embodied Agents
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown remarkable general capabilities, yet embodied agents built on them fail at complex tasks, often skipping critical steps, proposing invalid actions, and repeating mistakes.
