Furthermore, because it is a straightforward text-to-text generation method, we can easily adapt our approach to various types of argumentative structures. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, as it achieves state-of-the-art performance on three different types of benchmark datasets: the Argument-annotated Essays Corpus(AAEC), AbstRCT, and the Cornell eRulemaking Corpus(CDCP)

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于文本到文本生成的简单而强大的论证挖掘方法，使用预训练的编码器-解码器语言模型同时生成论证标注文本，无需任务特定的后处理和超参数调优。
AI.motivation: 传统论证挖掘方法需要多个子任务（跨度识别、组件分类、关系分类）和基于规则的后处理，增加了模型复杂性和超参数搜索空间，需要更简单有效的方法。
AI.method: 采用基于预训练编码器-解码器语言模型的文本到文本生成方法，同时生成跨度、组件和关系的论证标注文本，无需任务特定的后处理。
AI.result: 在三个不同类型的基准数据集（AAEC、AbstRCT、CDCP）上实现了最先进的性能，证明了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的文本到文本生成方法简化了论证挖掘流程，消除了复杂的后处理和超参数调优需求，并能轻松适应不同类型的论证结构。

title: SynMVCrowd: A Large Synthetic Benchmark for Multi-view Crowd Counting and Localization
summary: Existing multi-view crowd counting and localization methods are evaluated under relatively small scenes with limited crowd numbers, camera views, and frames. This makes the evaluation and comparison of existing methods impractical, as small datasets are easily overfit by these methods. To avoid these issues, 3DROM proposes a data augmentation method. Instead, in this paper, we propose a large synthetic benchmark, SynMVCrowd, for more practical evaluation and comparison of multi-view crowd counting and localization tasks. The SynMVCrowd benchmark consists of 50 synthetic scenes with a large number of multi-view frames and camera views and a much larger crowd number (up to 1000), which is more suitable for large-scene multi-view crowd vision tasks. Besides, we propose strong multi-view crowd localization and counting baselines that outperform all comparison methods on the new SynMVCrowd benchmark. Moreover, we prove that better domain transferring multi-view and single-image counting performance could be achieved with the aid of the benchmark on novel new real scenes. As a result, the proposed benchmark could advance the research for multi-view and single-image crowd counting and localization to more practical applications. The codes and datasets are here: https://github.com/zqyq/SynMVCrowd.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SynMVCrowd，一个用于多视角人群计数和定位任务的大型合成基准数据集，包含50个合成场景、大量多视角帧和摄像头视角，最多支持1000人，旨在解决现有方法在小数据集上容易过拟合的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有多视角人群计数和定位方法通常在规模较小的场景中进行评估，这些场景的人群数量、摄像头视角和帧数都有限，导致现有方法容易在这些小数据集上过拟合，使得评估和比较变得不切实际。
AI.method: 提出了SynMVCrowd大型合成基准数据集，包含50个合成场景，具有大量多视角帧和摄像头视角，人群数量最多可达1000人。同时提出了强大的多视角人群定位和计数基线方法。
AI.result: 提出的基线方法在新的SynMVCrowd基准上优于所有比较方法。此外，证明借助该基准可以在新的真实场景上实现更好的领域迁移多视角和单图像计数性能。
AI.conclusion: 提出的SynMVCrowd基准能够推动多视角和单图像人群计数与定位研究向更实际的应用发展，代码和数据集已开源。

title: From AI Assistant to AI Scientist: Autonomous Discovery of LLM-RL Algorithms with LLM Agents
summary: Discovering improved policy optimization algorithms for language models remains a costly manual process requiring repeated mechanism-level modification and validation. Unlike simple combinatorial code search, this problem requires searching over algorithmic mechanisms tightly coupled with training dynamics while reusing empirical evidence across iterations. We propose POISE, a closed-loop framework for automated discovery of policy optimization algorithms for language models. POISE maintains a structured, genealogically linked archive linking proposals, executable implementations, standardized evaluations, and natural-language reflections to support evidence-driven iteration. In mathematical reasoning experiments starting from GRPO, POISE evaluates 64 candidate algorithms and discovers improved mechanisms, including analytic-variance scaling and validity masking. The best variant improves weighted Overall from 47.8 to 52.5 (+4.6) and increases AIME25 pass@32 from 26.7% to 43.3%, demonstrating the feasibility of automated policy optimization discovery while supporting interpretable design principles.

AI.tldr: POISE是一个用于自动发现语言模型策略优化算法的闭环框架，通过结构化存档和证据驱动迭代，在数学推理实验中从GRPO出发评估64个候选算法，发现了改进机制并显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 为语言模型发现改进的策略优化算法目前是一个成本高昂的手动过程，需要重复的机制级修改和验证。这个问题不同于简单的组合代码搜索，需要搜索与训练动态紧密耦合的算法机制，并在迭代中重用经验证据。
AI.method: 提出POISE框架，维护一个结构化、具有谱系链接的存档，连接提案、可执行实现、标准化评估和自然语言反思，支持证据驱动的迭代。在数学推理实验中从GRPO出发，评估64个候选算法。
AI.result: 发现了改进的机制，包括分析方差缩放和有效性掩码。最佳变体将加权Overall从47.8提高到52.5（+4.6），并将AIME25 pass@32从26.7%提高到43.3%。
AI.conclusion: POISE框架证明了自动发现策略优化算法的可行性，同时支持可解释的设计原则，为语言模型优化算法的自动化发现提供了有效途径。

title: The Price Reversal Phenomenon: When Cheaper Reasoning Models End Up Costing More
summary: Developers and consumers increasingly choose reasoning language models (RLMs) based on their listed API prices. However, how accurately do these prices reflect actual inference costs? We conduct the first systematic study of this question, evaluating 8 frontier RLMs across 9 diverse tasks covering competition math, science QA, code generation, and multi-domain reasoning. We uncover the pricing reversal phenomenon: in 21.8% of model-pair comparisons, the model with a lower listed price actually incurs a higher total cost, with reversal magnitude reaching up to 28x. For example, Gemini 3 Flash's listed price is 78% cheaper than GPT-5.2's, yet its actual cost across all tasks is 22% higher. We trace the root cause to vast heterogeneity in thinking token consumption: on the same query, one model may use 900% more thinking tokens than another. In fact, removing thinking token costs reduces ranking reversals by 70% and raises the rank correlation (Kendall's $τ$ ) between price and cost rankings from 0.563 to 0.873. We further show that per-query cost prediction is fundamentally difficult: repeated runs of the same query yield thinking token variation up to 9.7x, establishing an irreducible noise floor for any predictor. Our findings demonstrate that listed API pricing is an unreliable proxy for actual cost, calling for cost-aware model selection and transparent per-request cost monitoring.

AI.tldr: 研究发现API价格与实际推理成本存在显著差异，21.8%的模型对比中出现"价格反转"现象，即标价更低的模型实际成本反而更高，最高可达28倍差异
AI.motivation: 开发者和消费者通常基于API价格选择推理语言模型，但这些价格是否能准确反映实际推理成本尚不清楚，需要进行系统性研究
AI.method: 评估8个前沿推理语言模型在9个多样化任务上的表现，涵盖竞赛数学、科学问答、代码生成和多领域推理，分析价格与实际成本的关系
AI.result: 发现21.8%的模型对比中出现价格反转现象，最高反转幅度达28倍；思考令牌消耗存在巨大异质性，同一查询下不同模型的思考令牌使用量差异可达900%；去除思考令牌成本可将排名反转减少70%
AI.conclusion: API标价不能可靠反映实际成本，需要成本感知的模型选择和透明的每请求成本监控，同时查询成本预测存在根本性困难

title: Leave No Stone Unturned: Uncovering Holistic Audio-Visual Intrinsic Coherence for Deepfake Detection
summary: The rapid progress of generative AI has enabled hyper-realistic audio-visual deepfakes, intensifying threats to personal security and social trust. Most existing deepfake detectors rely either on uni-modal artifacts or audio-visual discrepancies, failing to jointly leverage both sources of information. Moreover, detectors that rely on generator-specific artifacts tend to exhibit degraded generalization when confronted with unseen forgeries. We argue that robust and generalizable detection should be grounded in intrinsic audio-visual coherence within and across modalities. Accordingly, we propose HAVIC, a Holistic Audio-Visual Intrinsic Coherence-based deepfake detector. HAVIC first learns priors of modality-specific structural coherence, inter-modal micro- and macro-coherence by pre-training on authentic videos. Based on the learned priors, HAVIC further performs holistic adaptive aggregation to dynamically fuse audio-visual features for deepfake detection. Additionally, we introduce HiFi-AVDF, a high-fidelity audio-visual deepfake dataset featuring both text-to-video and image-to-video forgeries from state-of-the-art commercial generators. Extensive experiments across several benchmarks demonstrate that HAVIC significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, achieving improvements of 9.39% AP and 9.37% AUC on the most challenging cross-dataset scenario. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/tuffy-studio/HAVIC.

AI.tldr: HAVIC是一个基于音频-视觉内在一致性的深度伪造检测器，通过预训练学习模态间和模态内的结构一致性先验，并采用自适应特征融合，在跨数据集场景中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI的快速发展使得音频-视觉深度伪造变得超现实，威胁个人安全和社会信任。现有检测器要么依赖单模态伪影，要么依赖音频-视觉差异，未能联合利用两种信息源。此外，依赖生成器特定伪影的检测器在面对未见伪造时泛化能力下降。
AI.method: 提出HAVIC（整体音频-视觉内在一致性检测器）：1）在真实视频上预训练，学习模态特定结构一致性、模态间微观和宏观一致性的先验；2）基于学习到的先验，执行整体自适应聚合，动态融合音频-视觉特征进行深度伪造检测；3）引入HiFi-AVDF高质量音频-视觉深度伪造数据集。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，HAVIC显著优于现有最先进方法，在最具挑战性的跨数据集场景中实现了9.39% AP和9.37% AUC的提升。
AI.conclusion: 基于音频-视觉内在一致性的检测方法比依赖生成器特定伪影的方法更鲁棒和可泛化。HAVIC通过联合利用模态内和模态间一致性，实现了卓越的检测性能，特别是在跨数据集场景中。

title: Grounding Arabic LLMs in the Doha Historical Dictionary: Retrieval-Augmented Understanding of Quran and Hadith
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in many language tasks, yet they continue to struggle with complex historical and religious Arabic texts such as the Quran and Hadith. To address this limitation, we develop a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework grounded in diachronic lexicographic knowledge. Unlike prior RAG systems that rely on general-purpose corpora, our approach retrieves evidence from the Doha Historical Dictionary of Arabic (DHDA), a large-scale resource documenting the historical development of Arabic vocabulary. The proposed pipeline combines hybrid retrieval with an intent-based routing mechanism to provide LLMs with precise, contextually relevant historical information. Our experiments show that this approach improves the accuracy of Arabic-native LLMs, including Fanar and ALLaM, to over 85\%, substantially reducing the performance gap with Gemini, a proprietary large-scale model. Gemini also serves as an LLM-as-a-judge system for automatic evaluation in our experiments. The automated judgments were verified through human evaluation, demonstrating high agreement (kappa = 0.87). An error analysis further highlights key linguistic challenges, including diacritics and compound expressions. These findings demonstrate the value of integrating diachronic lexicographic resources into retrieval-augmented generation frameworks to enhance Arabic language understanding, particularly for historical and religious texts. The code and resources are publicly available at: https://github.com/somayaeltanbouly/Doha-Dictionary-RAG.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个基于历时词典知识的检索增强生成框架，专门用于处理复杂的历史和宗教阿拉伯语文本，显著提升了阿拉伯语原生大语言模型在《古兰经》和《圣训》等文本上的理解准确率。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型在许多语言任务上取得了显著进展，但在处理复杂的历史和宗教阿拉伯语文本（如《古兰经》和《圣训》）时仍然存在困难。现有检索增强生成系统通常依赖通用语料库，缺乏专门针对阿拉伯语历时词汇发展的知识资源。
AI.method: 开发了一个基于历时词典知识的检索增强生成框架，核心是使用多哈阿拉伯语历史词典作为检索源。该框架结合了混合检索方法和基于意图的路由机制，为大语言模型提供精确、上下文相关的历史信息。
AI.result: 该方法将阿拉伯语原生大语言模型（包括Fanar和ALLaM）的准确率提升至85%以上，显著缩小了与专有大规模模型Gemini的性能差距。使用Gemini作为LLM-as-a-judge自动评估系统，并通过人工评估验证，显示出高度一致性（kappa = 0.87）。错误分析进一步揭示了包括变音符号和复合表达在内的关键语言挑战。
AI.conclusion: 将历时词典资源整合到检索增强生成框架中，能够显著增强阿拉伯语理解能力，特别是在历史和宗教文本处理方面。该方法为处理复杂阿拉伯语文本提供了有效解决方案，相关代码和资源已公开。

title: SLAT-Phys: Fast Material Property Field Prediction from Structured 3D Latents
summary: Estimating the material property field of 3D assets is critical for physics-based simulation, robotics, and digital twin generation. Existing vision-based approaches are either too expensive and slow or rely on 3D information. We present SLAT-Phys, an end-to-end method that predicts spatially varying material property fields of 3D assets directly from a single RGB image without explicit 3D reconstruction. Our approach leverages spatially organised latent features from a pretrained 3D asset generation model that encodes rich geometry and semantic prior, and trains a lightweight neural decoder to estimate Young's modulus, density, and Poisson's ratio. The coarse volumetric layout and semantic cues of the latent representation about object geometry and appearance enable accurate material estimation. Our experiments demonstrate that our method provides competitive accuracy in predicting continuous material parameters when compared against prior approaches, while significantly reducing computation time. In particular, SLAT-Phys requires only 9.9 seconds per object on an NVIDIA RTXA5000 GPU and avoids reconstruction and voxelization preprocessing. This results in 120x speedup compared to prior methods and enables faster material property estimation from a single image.

AI.tldr: SLAT-Phys：从单张RGB图像直接预测3D资产材料属性场的端到端方法，无需显式3D重建，速度比现有方法快120倍
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉的材料属性估计方法要么成本高、速度慢，要么依赖3D信息。需要一种能从单张RGB图像快速准确预测3D资产材料属性的方法
AI.method: 利用预训练3D资产生成模型的空间组织潜在特征（编码丰富的几何和语义先验），训练轻量级神经解码器来估计杨氏模量、密度和泊松比
AI.result: 在NVIDIA RTXA5000 GPU上每个物体仅需9.9秒，避免重建和体素化预处理，比现有方法快120倍，同时在预测连续材料参数方面具有竞争力
AI.conclusion: SLAT-Phys实现了从单张RGB图像快速准确预测3D资产材料属性场，为物理模拟、机器人和数字孪生生成提供了高效解决方案

title: CoCR-RAG: Enhancing Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Web Q&A via Concept-oriented Context Reconstruction
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has shown promising results in enhancing Q&A by incorporating information from the web and other external sources. However, the supporting documents retrieved from the heterogeneous web often originate from multiple sources with diverse writing styles, varying formats, and inconsistent granularity. Fusing such multi-source documents into a coherent and knowledge-intensive context remains a significant challenge, as the presence of irrelevant and redundant information can compromise the factual consistency of the inferred answers. This paper proposes the Concept-oriented Context Reconstruction RAG (CoCR-RAG), a framework that addresses the multi-source information fusion problem in RAG through linguistically grounded concept-level integration. Specifically, we introduce a concept distillation algorithm that extracts essential concepts from Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR), a stable semantic representation that structures the meaning of texts as logical graphs. The distilled concepts from multiple retrieved documents are then fused and reconstructed into a unified, information-intensive context by Large Language Models, which supplement only the necessary sentence elements to highlight the core knowledge. Experiments on the PopQA and EntityQuestions datasets demonstrate that CoCR-RAG significantly outperforms existing context-reconstruction methods across these Web Q&A benchmarks. Furthermore, CoCR-RAG shows robustness across various backbone LLMs, establishing itself as a flexible, plug-and-play component adaptable to different RAG frameworks.

AI.tldr: CoCR-RAG框架通过概念蒸馏和重构解决多源文档融合问题，在Web问答基准上显著优于现有方法
AI.motivation: RAG在增强问答方面表现良好，但来自异构网络的多源文档存在写作风格、格式和粒度不一致的问题，融合这些文档形成连贯的知识密集型上下文仍然是一个重大挑战，不相关和冗余信息会影响答案的事实一致性。
AI.method: 提出概念导向的上下文重构RAG框架，使用概念蒸馏算法从抽象意义表示中提取核心概念，然后将多个文档的蒸馏概念通过大语言模型融合重构为统一的、信息密集的上下文，仅补充必要的句子元素来突出核心知识。
AI.result: 在PopQA和EntityQuestions数据集上的实验表明，CoCR-RAG显著优于现有的上下文重构方法，并且在各种骨干大语言模型上表现出鲁棒性，成为一个灵活的即插即用组件。
AI.conclusion: CoCR-RAG通过基于语言学的概念级集成有效解决了RAG中的多源信息融合问题，提高了事实一致性，并具有跨不同RAG框架的适应性。

title: HyDRA: Hybrid Domain-Aware Robust Architecture for Heterogeneous Collaborative Perception
summary: In collaborative perception, an agent's performance can be degraded by heterogeneity arising from differences in model architecture or training data distributions. To address this challenge, we propose HyDRA (Hybrid Domain-Aware Robust Architecture), a unified pipeline that integrates intermediate and late fusion within a domain-aware framework. We introduce a lightweight domain classifier that dynamically identifies heterogeneous agents and assigns them to the late-fusion branch. Furthermore, we propose anchor-guided pose graph optimization to mitigate localization errors inherent in late fusion, leveraging reliable detections from intermediate fusion as fixed spatial anchors. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, despite requiring no additional training, HyDRA achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art heterogeneity-aware CP methods. Importantly, this performance is maintained as the number of collaborating agents increases, enabling zero-cost scaling without retraining.

AI.tldr: HyDRA提出了一种统一的协作感知架构，通过动态识别异构智能体并分配融合策略，结合中间融合和后期融合，无需额外训练即可实现与最先进方法相当的性能，且能零成本扩展。
AI.motivation: 协作感知中，智能体间的异构性（模型架构或训练数据分布差异）会降低性能，现有方法难以有效处理这种异构性带来的挑战。
AI.method: 提出HyDRA统一流水线：1）轻量级域分类器动态识别异构智能体并分配至后期融合分支；2）锚点引导的姿态图优化利用中间融合的可靠检测作为空间锚点，减轻后期融合中的定位误差。
AI.result: 实验表明，HyDRA无需额外训练即可达到与最先进的异构感知协作感知方法相当的性能，且随着协作智能体数量增加，性能保持稳定，实现零成本扩展。
AI.conclusion: HyDRA通过统一的域感知架构有效解决了协作感知中的异构性问题，实现了高性能、可扩展且无需重新训练的解决方案。

title: Sparse Growing Transformer: Training-Time Sparse Depth Allocation via Progressive Attention Looping
summary: Existing approaches to increasing the effective depth of Transformers predominantly rely on parameter reuse, extending computation through recursive execution. Under this paradigm, the network structure remains static along the training timeline, and additional computational depth is uniformly assigned to entire blocks at the parameter level. This rigidity across training time and parameter space leads to substantial computational redundancy during training. In contrast, we argue that depth allocation during training should not be a static preset, but rather a progressively growing structural process. Our systematic analysis reveals a deep-to-shallow maturation trajectory across layers, where high-entropy attention heads play a crucial role in semantic integration. Motivated by this observation, we introduce the Sparse Growing Transformer (SGT). SGT is a training-time sparse depth allocation framework that progressively extends recurrence from deeper to shallower layers via targeted attention looping on informative heads. This mechanism induces structural sparsity by selectively increasing depth only for a small subset of parameters as training evolves. Extensive experiments across multiple parameter scales demonstrate that SGT consistently outperforms training-time static block-level looping baselines under comparable settings, while reducing the additional training FLOPs overhead from approximately 16--20% to only 1--3% relative to a standard Transformer backbone.

AI.tldr: SGT是一种训练时稀疏深度分配框架，通过选择性注意力循环在信息丰富的注意力头上，从深层到浅层逐步扩展递归，显著减少训练计算冗余。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通过参数重用增加Transformer深度，但存在训练时间静态和参数空间均匀分配的刚性，导致大量计算冗余。研究发现层间存在从深到浅的成熟轨迹，高熵注意力头在语义整合中起关键作用。
AI.method: 提出稀疏增长Transformer（SGT），在训练时稀疏分配深度，通过目标注意力循环在信息丰富的头上，从深层到浅层逐步扩展递归，仅对一小部分参数选择性增加深度。
AI.result: 在多个参数规模下，SGT在可比设置下始终优于训练时静态块级循环基线，同时将额外训练FLOPs开销从约16-20%减少到仅1-3%（相对于标准Transformer骨干）。
AI.conclusion: 深度分配应是渐进增长的结构过程而非静态预设，SGT通过训练时稀疏深度分配机制，在保持性能优势的同时显著降低计算成本，为高效Transformer训练提供了新范式。

title: SilLang: Improving Gait Recognition with Silhouette Language Encoding
summary: Gait silhouettes, which can be encoded into binary gait codes, are widely adopted to representing motion patterns of pedestrian. Recent approaches commonly leverage visual backbones to encode gait silhouettes, achieving successful performance. However, they primarily focus on continuous visual features, overlooking the discrete nature of binary silhouettes that inherently share a discrete encoding space with natural language. Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated exceptional capability in extracting discriminative features from discrete sequences and modeling long-range dependencies, highlighting their potential to capture temporal motion patterns by identifying subtle variations. Motivated by these observations, we explore bridging binary gait silhouettes and natural language within a binary encoding space. However, the encoding spaces of text tokens and binary gait silhouettes remain misaligned, primarily due to differences in token frequency and density. To address this issue, we propose the Contour-Velocity Tokenizer, which encodes binary gait silhouettes while reshaping their distribution to better align with the text token space. We then establish a dual-branch framework termed Silhouette Language Model, which enhances visual silhouettes by integrating discrete linguistic embeddings derived from LLMs. Implemented on mainstream gait backbones, SilLang consistently improves state-of-the-art methods across SUSTech1K, GREW, and Gait3D.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SilLang框架，通过轮廓-速度分词器将二进制步态轮廓与自然语言在离散编码空间对齐，利用大语言模型增强步态识别性能
AI.motivation: 现有步态识别方法主要关注连续视觉特征，忽略了二进制步态轮廓的离散特性，而大语言模型在离散序列特征提取和长距离依赖建模方面表现出色，具有捕捉时序运动模式的潜力
AI.method: 提出轮廓-速度分词器，将二进制步态轮廓编码并重新分布以对齐文本标记空间；建立双分支SilLang框架，集成大语言模型的离散语言嵌入来增强视觉轮廓特征
AI.result: 在SUSTech1K、GREW和Gait3D三个主流数据集上，SilLang框架持续提升了现有最优方法的性能
AI.conclusion: 通过将二进制步态轮廓与自然语言在离散编码空间对齐，并利用大语言模型增强视觉特征，可以有效提升步态识别性能

title: Thinking with Tables: Enhancing Multi-Modal Tabular Understanding via Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable reasoning capabilities across modalities such as images and text. However, tabular data, despite being a critical real-world modality, remains relatively underexplored in multimodal learning. In this paper, we focus on the task of Tabular-Vision Multi-Modal Understanding (TVMU) and identify three core challenges: (1) high structural variability and data incompleteness in tables, (2) implicit and complex feature dependencies, and (3) significant heterogeneity in problem-solving pipelines across downstream tasks. To address these issues, we propose Thinking with Tables (TWT). TWT employs a program-aided code-based neuro-symbolic reasoning mechanism that facilitates key operations, such as information extraction and element modeling, by interacting with external environments. We evaluate TWT on eight representative datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that TWT consistently outperforms existing baselines by an average of 10\% in accuracy, achieving performance comparable to, or even surpassing, proprietary commercial SOTA LLMs on TVMU tasks. Models and codes are available at https://github.com/kunyang-YU/Thinking-with-Tables

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了TWT（Thinking with Tables）方法，通过程序辅助的代码神经符号推理机制解决表格视觉多模态理解任务中的挑战，在8个数据集上平均准确率提升10%，性能媲美甚至超越商业SOTA LLM。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在图像和文本模态上表现出色，但表格数据这一关键现实模态在多模态学习中相对未被充分探索。表格数据存在高结构可变性、数据不完整性、隐式复杂特征依赖以及下游任务间显著异质性等核心挑战。
AI.method: 提出TWT（Thinking with Tables）方法，采用程序辅助的代码神经符号推理机制，通过与外部环境交互实现信息提取和元素建模等关键操作，解决表格视觉多模态理解任务中的挑战。
AI.result: 在8个代表性数据集上进行评估，TWT在准确率上平均比现有基线方法提升10%，在表格视觉多模态理解任务上达到甚至超越了专有商业SOTA大语言模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: TWT通过神经符号推理机制有效解决了表格数据在多模态理解中的独特挑战，为表格视觉多模态理解任务提供了有效的解决方案，性能显著优于现有方法。

title: CAKE: Real-time Action Detection via Motion Distillation and Background-aware Contrastive Learning
summary: Online Action Detection (OAD) systems face two primary challenges: high computational cost and insufficient modeling of discriminative temporal dynamics against background motion. Adding optical flow could provides strong motion cues but it incurs significant computational overhead. We propose CAKE, a OAD Flow-based distillation framework to transfer motion knowledge into RGB models. We propose Dynamic Motion Adapter (DMA) to suppress static background noise and emphasize pixel changes, effectively approximating optical flow without explicit computation. The framework also integrates a Floating Contrastive Learning strategy to distinguish informative motion dynamics from temporal background. Various experiments conducted on the TVSeries, THUMOS'14, Kinetics-400 datasets show effectiveness of our model. CAKE achieves a standout mAP compared with SOTA while using the same backbone. Our model operates at over 72 FPS on a single CPU, making it highly suitable for resource-constrained systems.

AI.tldr: CAKE是一个用于在线动作检测的流蒸馏框架，通过动态运动适配器近似光流效果，结合浮动对比学习区分运动动态，在保持高帧率的同时达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 在线动作检测面临两大挑战：计算成本高和难以建模区分性时间动态。虽然光流能提供强运动线索，但计算开销大。需要一种既能捕捉运动信息又计算高效的方法。
AI.method: 提出CAKE框架：1) 动态运动适配器(DMA)抑制静态背景噪声，强调像素变化，近似光流效果而无需显式计算；2) 浮动对比学习策略区分信息性运动动态与时间背景；3) 基于流的知识蒸馏将运动知识转移到RGB模型中。
AI.result: 在TVSeries、THUMOS'14、Kinetics-400数据集上验证有效性，达到SOTA的mAP性能，同时使用相同骨干网络。模型在单CPU上运行超过72 FPS，适合资源受限系统。
AI.conclusion: CAKE框架成功解决了在线动作检测的计算效率和运动建模问题，通过知识蒸馏和创新的适配器设计，在保持实时性能的同时实现了优异的检测精度。

title: CVPD at QIAS 2026: RAG-Guided LLM Reasoning for Al-Mawarith Share Computation and Heir Allocation
summary:
Islamic inheritance (Ilm al-Mawarith) is a multi-stage legal reasoning task requiring the identification of eligible heirs, resolution of blocking rules (hajb), assignment of fixed and residual shares, handling of adjustments such as awl and radd, and generation of a consistent final distribution. The task is further complicated by variations across legal schools and civil-law codifications, requiring models to operate under explicit legal configurations.
  We present a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline for this setting, combining rule-grounded synthetic data generation, hybrid retrieval (dense and BM25) with cross-encoder reranking, and schema-constrained output validation. A symbolic inheritance calculator is used to generate a large high-quality synthetic corpus with full intermediate reasoning traces, ensuring legal and numerical consistency.
  The proposed system achieves a MIR-E score of 0.935 and ranks first on the official QIAS 2026 blind-test leaderboard. Results demonstrate that retrieval-grounded, schema-aware generation significantly improves reliability in high-precision Arabic legal reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出基于检索增强生成(RAG)的伊斯兰继承法推理系统，结合符号计算器生成合成数据、混合检索与模式约束验证，在QIAS 2026盲测中排名第一
AI.motivation: 伊斯兰继承法推理任务复杂，涉及多阶段法律推理、不同法学派别差异和民法法典化变体，需要高精度阿拉伯语法律推理系统
AI.method: 采用RAG管道：1) 基于规则生成高质量合成数据；2) 混合检索（稠密+BM25）与交叉编码器重排序；3) 模式约束输出验证；4) 使用符号继承计算器确保法律和数值一致性
AI.result: 系统MIR-E得分0.935，在官方QIAS 2026盲测排行榜上排名第一，证明检索增强、模式感知生成显著提高了阿拉伯语法律推理任务的可靠性
AI.conclusion: 检索增强、模式感知的生成方法能有效处理复杂的伊斯兰继承法推理任务，为高精度阿拉伯语法律推理系统提供了可靠解决方案

title: HGGT: Robust and Flexible 3D Hand Mesh Reconstruction from Uncalibrated Images
summary: Recovering high-fidelity 3D hand geometry from images is a critical task in computer vision, holding significant value for domains such as robotics, animation and VR/AR. Crucially, scalable applications demand both accuracy and deployment flexibility, requiring the ability to leverage massive amounts of unstructured image data from the internet or enable deployment on consumer-grade RGB cameras without complex calibration. However, current methods face a dilemma. While single-view approaches are easy to deploy, they suffer from depth ambiguity and occlusion. Conversely, multi-view systems resolve these uncertainties but typically demand fixed, calibrated setups, limiting their real-world utility. To bridge this gap, we draw inspiration from 3D foundation models that learn explicit geometry directly from visual data. By reformulating hand reconstruction from arbitrary views as a visual-geometry grounded task, we propose a feed-forward architecture that, for the first time in literature, jointly infers 3D hand meshes and camera poses from uncalibrated views. Extensive evaluations show that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art benchmarks and demonstrates strong generalization to uncalibrated, in-the-wild scenarios. Here is the link of our project page: https://lym29.github.io/HGGT/.

AI.tldr: 提出一种从任意未标定视角联合推断3D手部网格和相机姿态的前馈架构，解决单视角深度模糊和多视角标定限制的困境
AI.motivation: 从图像中恢复高保真3D手部几何在机器人、动画和VR/AR领域有重要价值。现有方法面临困境：单视角方法易于部署但存在深度模糊和遮挡问题；多视角系统能解决不确定性但通常需要固定标定设置，限制了实际应用
AI.method: 受3D基础模型直接从视觉数据学习显式几何的启发，将任意视角的手部重建重新表述为视觉几何接地任务，提出前馈架构首次在文献中从未标定视角联合推断3D手部网格和相机姿态
AI.result: 广泛评估表明，该方法优于最先进的基准方法，并在未标定的野外场景中表现出强大的泛化能力
AI.conclusion: 通过将手部重建重新表述为视觉几何接地任务，提出了一种能够从未标定视角联合恢复3D手部几何和相机姿态的创新方法，弥合了单视角和多视角方法之间的差距

title: Schema on the Inside: A Two-Phase Fine-Tuning Method for High-Efficiency Text-to-SQL at Scale
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Published in the Proceedings of the Fortieth AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI-26), 2026
summary: Applying large, proprietary API-based language models to text-to-SQL tasks poses a significant industry challenge: reliance on massive, schema-heavy prompts results in prohibitive per-token API costs and high latency, hindering scalable production deployment. We present a specialized, self-hosted 8B-parameter model designed for a conversational bot in CriQ, a sister app to Dream11, India's largest fantasy sports platform with over 250 million users, that answers user queries about cricket statistics. Our novel two-phase supervised fine-tuning approach enables the model to internalize the entire database schema, eliminating the need for long-context prompts. This reduces input tokens by over 99%, from a 17k-token baseline to fewer than 100, and replaces costly external API calls with efficient local inference. The resulting system achieves 98.4% execution success and 92.5% semantic accuracy, substantially outperforming a prompt-engineered baseline using Google's Gemini Flash 2.0 (95.6% execution, 89.4% semantic accuracy). These results demonstrate a practical path toward high-precision, low-latency text-to-SQL applications using domain-specialized, self-hosted language models in large-scale production environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种专门用于板球统计查询的8B参数自托管模型，通过两阶段监督微调方法，将输入token从17k减少到少于100个，实现了99%的token减少，在Dream11平台上取得了98.4%执行成功率和92.5%语义准确率。
AI.motivation: 解决在文本到SQL任务中使用大型专有API模型时面临的高成本和高延迟问题。传统方法需要大量包含数据库架构的提示，导致每个token的API成本过高且延迟显著，阻碍了在生产环境中的可扩展部署。
AI.method: 开发了一个专门的8B参数自托管模型，采用新颖的两阶段监督微调方法，使模型能够内化整个数据库架构，从而无需长上下文提示。该方法将输入token从17k基线减少到少于100个，并用高效的本地推理替代昂贵的外部API调用。
AI.result: 系统实现了98.4%的执行成功率和92.5%的语义准确率，显著优于使用Google Gemini Flash 2.0的提示工程基线（95.6%执行成功率，89.4%语义准确率）。输入token减少了99%以上，从17k减少到少于100个。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了一条使用领域专业化、自托管语言模型在大规模生产环境中实现高精度、低延迟文本到SQL应用的实用路径，为类似应用提供了成本效益和性能优化的解决方案。

title: DB SwinT: A Dual-Branch Swin Transformer Network for Road Extraction in Optical Remote Sensing Imagery
summary: With the continuous improvement in the spatial resolution of optical remote sensing imagery, accurate road extraction has become increasingly important for applications such as urban planning, traffic monitoring, and disaster management. However, road extraction in complex urban and rural environments remains challenging, as roads are often occluded by trees, buildings, and other objects, leading to fragmented structures and reduced extraction accuracy. To address this problem, this paper proposes a Dual-Branch Swin Transformer network (DB SwinT) for road extraction. The proposed framework combines the long-range dependency modeling capability of the Swin Transformer with the multi-scale feature fusion strategy of U-Net, and employs a dual-branch encoder to learn complementary local and global representations. Specifically, the local branch focuses on recovering fine structural details in occluded areas, while the global branch captures broader semantic context to preserve the overall continuity of road networks. In addition, an Attentional Feature Fusion (AFF) module is introduced to adaptively fuse features from the two branches, further enhancing the representation of occluded road segments. Experimental results on the Massachusetts and DeepGlobe datasets show that DB SwinT achieves Intersection over Union (IoU) scores of 79.35\% and 74.84\%, respectively, demonstrating its effectiveness for road extraction from optical remote sensing imagery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DB SwinT网络，结合Swin Transformer的长距离依赖建模能力和U-Net的多尺度特征融合策略，通过双分支编码器学习互补的局部和全局表示，用于光学遥感影像中的道路提取。
AI.motivation: 随着光学遥感影像空间分辨率的不断提高，准确的道路提取对于城市规划、交通监测和灾害管理等应用变得越来越重要。然而，在复杂的城乡环境中，道路经常被树木、建筑物等遮挡，导致结构碎片化，提取精度降低。
AI.method: 提出双分支Swin Transformer网络（DB SwinT），结合Swin Transformer的长距离依赖建模能力和U-Net的多尺度特征融合策略。采用双分支编码器：局部分支专注于恢复遮挡区域的精细结构细节，全局分支捕获更广泛的语义上下文以保持道路网络的整体连续性。引入注意力特征融合（AFF）模块自适应地融合两个分支的特征。
AI.result: 在Massachusetts和DeepGlobe数据集上的实验结果显示，DB SwinT分别获得了79.35%和74.84%的交并比（IoU）分数，证明了其在光学遥感影像道路提取中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DB SwinT网络通过双分支设计和注意力特征融合，有效解决了复杂环境中道路提取的遮挡和碎片化问题，在多个数据集上取得了优异的性能。

title: UW-VOS: A Large-Scale Dataset for Underwater Video Object Segmentation
summary: Underwater Video Object Segmentation (VOS) is essential for marine exploration, yet open-air methods suffer significant degradation due to color distortion, low contrast, and prevalent camouflage. A primary hurdle is the lack of high-quality training data. To bridge this gap, we introduce $\textbf{UW-VOS}$, the first large-scale underwater VOS benchmark comprising 1,431 video sequences across 409 categories with 309,295 mask annotations, constructed via a semi-automatic data engine with rigorous human verification. We further propose $\textbf{SAM-U}$, a parameter-efficient framework that adapts SAM2 to the underwater domain. By inserting lightweight adapters into the image encoder, SAM-U achieves state-of-the-art performance with only $\sim$2$\%$ trainable parameters. Extensive experiments reveal that existing methods experience an average 13-point $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ drop on UW-VOS, while SAM-U effectively bridges this domain gap. Detailed attribute-based analysis further identifies small targets, camouflage, and exit-re-entry as critical bottlenecks, providing a roadmap for future research in robust underwater perception.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了首个大规模水下视频目标分割基准数据集UW-VOS，并开发了参数高效的SAM-U框架，通过轻量适配器将SAM2适配到水下领域，显著提升了水下分割性能。
AI.motivation: 水下视频目标分割对海洋探索至关重要，但现有开放空间方法因颜色失真、低对比度和普遍伪装而性能显著下降，主要障碍是缺乏高质量训练数据。
AI.method: 1) 构建UW-VOS基准数据集：包含1,431个视频序列、409个类别、309,295个掩码标注，采用半自动数据引擎和严格人工验证；2) 提出SAM-U框架：在SAM2图像编码器中插入轻量适配器，仅需约2%可训练参数。
AI.result: 1) 现有方法在UW-VOS上平均下降13点J&F分数；2) SAM-U有效弥合领域差距，达到最先进性能；3) 属性分析识别出小目标、伪装和退出-重入是水下感知的关键瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: UW-VOS基准和SAM-U框架为水下视频目标分割研究提供了重要基础，识别了关键挑战领域，为未来鲁棒水下感知研究指明了方向。

title: FinToolSyn: A forward synthesis Framework for Financial Tool-Use Dialogue Data with Dynamic Tool Retrieval
summary: Tool-use capabilities are vital for Large Language Models (LLMs) in finance, a domain characterized by massive investment targets and data-intensive inquiries. However, existing data synthesis methods typically rely on a reverse synthesis paradigm, generating user queries from pre-sampled tools. This approach inevitably introduces artificial explicitness, yielding queries that fail to capture the implicit, event-driven nature of real-world needs. Moreover, its reliance on static tool sets overlooks the dynamic retrieval process required to navigate massive tool spaces. To address these challenges, we introduce \textit{FinToolSyn}, a forward synthesis framework designed to generate high-quality financial dialogues. Progressing from persona instruction and atomic tool synthesis to dynamic retrieval dialogue generation, our pipeline constructs a repository of 43,066 tools and synthesizes over 148k dialogue instances, incorporating dynamic retrieval to emulate the noisy candidate sets typical of massive tool spaces. We also establish a dedicated benchmark to evaluate tool-calling capabilities in realistic financial scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that models trained on FinToolSyn achieve a 21.06\% improvement, providing a robust foundation for tool learning in financial scenarios.

AI.tldr: FinToolSyn是一个前向合成的金融对话生成框架，通过从角色指令到原子工具合成再到动态检索对话生成的流程，构建了43,066个工具库和148k+对话实例，显著提升了金融场景下LLM的工具调用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有金融领域工具调用数据合成方法通常采用反向合成范式（从预采样工具生成用户查询），这种方法存在两个主要问题：1）引入人为显式性，无法捕捉真实世界需求的隐式、事件驱动特性；2）依赖静态工具集，忽略了在大规模工具空间中导航所需的动态检索过程。
AI.method: 提出FinToolSyn前向合成框架，包含三个渐进阶段：1）角色指令生成；2）原子工具合成；3）动态检索对话生成。该框架构建了包含43,066个工具的存储库，合成了超过148k个对话实例，并模拟大规模工具空间中典型的噪声候选集。
AI.result: 建立了专门的基准测试来评估真实金融场景下的工具调用能力。实验表明，在FinToolSyn上训练的模型实现了21.06%的性能提升，为金融场景下的工具学习提供了坚实基础。
AI.conclusion: FinToolSyn通过前向合成框架解决了现有反向合成方法的局限性，能够生成更符合真实金融场景需求的高质量对话数据，显著提升了LLM在金融领域的工具调用能力。

title: COVTrack++: Learning Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Tracking from Continuous Videos via a Synergistic Paradigm
summary: Multi-Object Tracking (MOT) has traditionally focused on a few specific categories, restricting its applicability to real-world scenarios involving diverse objects. Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Tracking (OVMOT) addresses this by enabling tracking of arbitrary categories, including novel objects unseen during training. However, current progress is constrained by two challenges: the lack of continuously annotated video data for training, and the lack of a customized OVMOT framework to synergistically handle detection and association. We address the data bottleneck by constructing C-TAO, the first continuously annotated training set for OVMOT, which increases annotation density by 26x over the original TAO and captures smooth motion dynamics and intermediate object states. For the framework bottleneck, we propose COVTrack++, a synergistic framework that achieves a bidirectional reciprocal mechanism between detection and association through three modules: (1) Multi-Cue Adaptive Fusion (MCF) dynamically balances appearance, motion, and semantic cues for association feature learning; (2) Multi-Granularity Hierarchical Aggregation (MGA) exploits hierarchical spatial relationships in dense detections, where visible child nodes (e.g., object parts) assist occluded parent objects (e.g., whole body) for association feature enhancement; (3) Temporal Confidence Propagation (TCP) recovers flickering detections through high-confidence tracked objects boosting low-confidence candidates across frames, stabilizing trajectories. Extensive experiments on TAO demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, with novel TETA reaching 35.4% and 30.5% on validation and test sets, improving novel AssocA by 4.8% and novel LocA by 5.8% over previous methods, and show strong zero-shot generalization on BDD100K. The code and dataset will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了COVTrack++框架和C-TAO数据集，解决了开放词汇多目标跟踪中的数据瓶颈和框架瓶颈问题，在TAO数据集上实现了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 传统多目标跟踪局限于特定类别，开放词汇多目标跟踪可以跟踪任意类别但面临两个挑战：缺乏连续标注的视频训练数据，以及缺乏专门处理检测和关联的协同框架。
AI.method: 构建C-TAO数据集（比原TAO标注密度高26倍），并提出COVTrack++框架，包含三个模块：多线索自适应融合（MCF）、多粒度层次聚合（MGA）和时间置信度传播（TCP）。
AI.result: 在TAO数据集上达到最先进性能，验证集和测试集的TETA分别为35.4%和30.5%，相比先前方法将新颖类别的AssocA提升4.8%，LocA提升5.8%，在BDD100K上表现出强大的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过C-TAO数据集和COVTrack++框架，有效解决了开放词汇多目标跟踪的数据和框架瓶颈，实现了对任意类别（包括未见类别）的鲁棒跟踪。

title: ConceptKT: A Benchmark for Concept-Level Deficiency Prediction in Knowledge Tracing
summary: Knowledge Tracing (KT) is a critical technique for modeling student knowledge to support personalized learning. However, most KT systems focus on binary correctness prediction and cannot diagnose the underlying conceptual misunderstandings that lead to errors. Such fine-grained diagnostic feedback is essential for designing targeted instruction and effective remediation. In this work, we introduce the task of concept-level deficiency prediction, which extends traditional KT by identifying the specific concepts a student is likely to struggle with on future problems. We present ConceptKT, a dataset annotated with labels that capture both the concepts required to solve each question and the missing concepts underlying incorrect responses. We investigate in-context learning approaches to KT and evaluate the diagnostic capabilities of various Large Language Models (LLMs) and Large Reasoning Models (LRMs). Different strategies for selecting informative historical records are explored. Experimental results demonstrate that selecting response histories based on conceptual alignment and semantic similarity leads to improved performance on both correctness prediction and concept-level deficiency identification.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出概念级缺陷预测任务，扩展传统知识追踪，通过分析学生历史答题记录来预测其未来可能遇到困难的具体概念，并构建了带概念标注的数据集ConceptKT。
AI.motivation: 传统知识追踪系统主要关注二元正确性预测，无法诊断导致错误的底层概念误解。这种细粒度的诊断反馈对于设计针对性教学和有效补救至关重要。
AI.method: 引入概念级缺陷预测任务，构建ConceptKT数据集（标注了每个问题所需概念和错误回答背后的缺失概念），研究上下文学习方法，评估不同LLM和LRM的诊断能力，探索基于概念对齐和语义相似性的历史记录选择策略。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，基于概念对齐和语义相似性选择响应历史记录的方法，在正确性预测和概念级缺陷识别两方面都提高了性能。
AI.conclusion: 概念级缺陷预测扩展了传统知识追踪能力，通过细粒度概念诊断为个性化学习提供更精准的支持，基于概念对齐的历史记录选择策略能有效提升模型性能。

title: Decompose and Transfer: CoT-Prompting Enhanced Alignment for Open-Vocabulary Temporal Action Detection
summary: Open-Vocabulary Temporal Action Detection (OV-TAD) aims to classify and localize action segments in untrimmed videos for unseen categories. Previous methods rely solely on global alignment between label-level semantics and visual features, which is insufficient to transfer temporal consistent visual knowledge from seen to unseen classes. To address this, we propose a Phase-wise Decomposition and Alignment (PDA) framework, which enables fine-grained action pattern learning for effective prior knowledge transfer. Specifically, we first introduce the CoT-Prompting Semantic Decomposition (CSD) module, which leverages the chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning ability of large language models to automatically decompose action labels into coherent phase-level descriptions, emulating human cognitive processes. Then, Text-infused Foreground Filtering (TIF) module is introduced to adaptively filter action-relevant segments for each phase leveraging phase-wise semantic cues, producing semantically aligned visual representations. Furthermore, we propose the Adaptive Phase-wise Alignment (APA) module to perform phase-level visual-textual matching, and adaptively aggregates alignment results across phases for final prediction. This adaptive phase-wise alignment facilitates the capture of transferable action patterns and significantly enhances generalization to unseen actions. Extensive experiments on two OV-TAD benchmarks demonstrated the superiority of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: PDA框架通过相位分解与对齐解决开放词汇时序动作检测问题，利用大语言模型分解动作标签为相位描述，进行细粒度视觉-文本匹配，显著提升未见类别的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇时序动作检测方法仅依赖标签级语义与视觉特征的全局对齐，无法将时序一致的视觉知识从已见类别迁移到未见类别，需要更细粒度的动作模式学习。
AI.method: 提出相位分解与对齐框架：1) CSD模块利用大语言模型的思维链推理能力自动分解动作标签为相位描述；2) TIF模块基于相位语义自适应过滤动作相关片段；3) APA模块进行相位级视觉-文本匹配并自适应聚合结果。
AI.result: 在两个开放词汇时序动作检测基准测试上进行了广泛实验，证明了所提方法的优越性，显著增强了未见动作的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过相位分解与对齐的细粒度动作模式学习，能够有效迁移先验知识，提升开放词汇时序动作检测的性能，特别是对未见类别的泛化能力。

title: LLMpedia: A Transparent Framework to Materialize an LLM's Encyclopedic Knowledge at Scale
summary: Benchmarks such as MMLU suggest flagship language models approach factuality saturation, with scores above 90\%. We show this picture is incomplete. \emph{LLMpedia} generates encyclopedic articles entirely from parametric memory, producing ${\sim}$1M articles across three model families without retrieval. For gpt-5-mini, the verifiable true rate on Wikipedia-covered subjects is only 74.7\% -- more than 15 percentage points below the benchmark-based picture, consistent with the availability bias of fixed-question evaluation. Beyond Wikipedia, frontier subjects verifiable only through curated web evidence fall further to 63.2\% true rate. Wikipedia covers just 61\% of surfaced subjects, and three model families overlap by only 7.3\% in subject choice. In a capture-trap benchmark inspired by prior analysis of Grokipedia, LLMpedia achieves substantially higher factuality at roughly half the textual similarity to Wikipedia. Unlike Grokipedia, every prompt, artifact, and evaluation verdict is publicly released, making LLMpedia the first fully open parametric encyclopedia -- bridging factuality evaluation and knowledge materialization. All data, code, and a browsable interface are at https://llmpedia.net.

AI.tldr: LLMpedia通过仅依赖参数化记忆生成百科全书文章，揭示了主流语言模型在事实性评估方面的局限性，真实率远低于传统基准测试的乐观估计。
AI.motivation: 传统基准测试（如MMLU）显示语言模型事实性得分超过90%，但这可能不完整。作者旨在通过生成完整的百科全书文章来更全面地评估模型的事实性表现。
AI.method: 创建LLMpedia系统，完全依赖参数化记忆（不进行检索）生成约100万篇百科全书文章，涵盖三个模型家族。通过验证真实率来评估模型事实性，并与Wikipedia覆盖情况进行对比。
AI.result: gpt-5-mini在Wikipedia覆盖主题上的真实率仅为74.7%，比基准测试估计低15个百分点以上；前沿主题真实率降至63.2%。Wikipedia仅覆盖61%的生成主题，三个模型家族的主题选择重叠率仅7.3%。
AI.conclusion: 传统固定问题评估存在可用性偏差，无法全面反映模型事实性。LLMpedia作为首个完全开放的参数化百科全书，弥合了事实性评估和知识物化之间的差距，提供了更全面的评估框架。

title: SpectralSplats: Robust Differentiable Tracking via Spectral Moment Supervision
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time, photorealistic novel view synthesis, making it a highly attractive representation for model-based video tracking. However, leveraging the differentiability of the 3DGS renderer "in the wild" remains notoriously fragile. A fundamental bottleneck lies in the compact, local support of the Gaussian primitives. Standard photometric objectives implicitly rely on spatial overlap; if severe camera misalignment places the rendered object outside the target's local footprint, gradients strictly vanish, leaving the optimizer stranded. We introduce SpectralSplats, a robust tracking framework that resolves this "vanishing gradient" problem by shifting the optimization objective from the spatial to the frequency domain. By supervising the rendered image via a set of global complex sinusoidal features (Spectral Moments), we construct a global basin of attraction, ensuring that a valid, directional gradient toward the target exists across the entire image domain, even when pixel overlap is completely nonexistent. To harness this global basin without introducing periodic local minima associated with high frequencies, we derive a principled Frequency Annealing schedule from first principles, gracefully transitioning the optimizer from global convexity to precise spatial alignment. We demonstrate that SpectralSplats acts as a seamless, drop-in replacement for spatial losses across diverse deformation parameterizations (from MLPs to sparse control points), successfully recovering complex deformations even from severely misaligned initializations where standard appearance-based tracking catastrophically fails.

AI.tldr: SpectralSplats通过将优化目标从空间域转移到频域，解决了3DGS跟踪中的梯度消失问题，使用全局频谱特征确保即使在没有像素重叠的情况下也能获得有效的梯度方向。
AI.motivation: 3D高斯泼溅(3DGS)虽然能实现实时逼真的新视角合成，但在实际应用中其可微渲染器的使用仍然非常脆弱。主要瓶颈在于高斯基元的紧凑局部支持特性：当相机严重错位导致渲染对象超出目标的局部覆盖范围时，标准光度目标的梯度会完全消失，使优化器陷入困境。
AI.method: 提出SpectralSplats跟踪框架，通过将优化目标从空间域转移到频域来解决梯度消失问题。使用一组全局复正弦特征（频谱矩）来监督渲染图像，构建全局吸引盆地。为避免高频引入的周期性局部最小值，从基本原理推导出频率退火调度策略，优雅地将优化器从全局凸性过渡到精确的空间对齐。
AI.result: SpectralSplats作为空间损失的即插即用替代方案，在各种变形参数化（从MLP到稀疏控制点）中都能成功恢复复杂变形，即使在严重错位的初始化情况下也能工作，而标准基于外观的跟踪在这种情况下会灾难性地失败。
AI.conclusion: 通过将优化目标从空间域转移到频域，SpectralSplats解决了3DGS跟踪中的根本性梯度消失问题，为"野外"使用3DGS可微渲染器提供了稳健的解决方案，即使在严重相机错位的情况下也能确保有效的梯度方向。

title: Alignment Reduces Expressed but Not Encoded Gender Bias: A Unified Framework and Study
summary: During training, Large Language Models (LLMs) learn social regularities that can lead to gender bias in downstream applications. Most mitigation efforts focus on reducing bias in generated outputs, typically evaluated on structured benchmarks, which raises two concerns: output-level evaluation does not reveal whether alignment modifies the model's underlying representations, and structured benchmarks may not reflect realistic usage scenarios. We propose a unified framework to jointly analyze intrinsic and extrinsic gender bias in LLMs using identical neutral prompts, enabling direct comparison between gender-related information encoded in internal representations and bias expressed in generated outputs. Contrary to prior work reporting weak or inconsistent correlations, we find a consistent association between latent gender information and expressed bias when measured under the unified protocol. We further examine the effect of alignment through supervised fine-tuning aimed at reducing gender bias. Our results suggest that while the latter indeed reduces expressed bias, measurable gender-related associations are still present in internal representations, and can be reactivated under adversarial prompting. Finally, we consider two realistic settings and show that debiasing effects observed on structured benchmarks do not necessarily generalize, e.g., to the case of story generation.

AI.tldr: 研究发现LLMs在训练中学习的社会规律会导致性别偏见，提出了统一框架分析内在和外在偏见，发现对齐训练减少了输出偏见但内部表征仍存在性别关联，且结构化基准的偏见缓解效果不一定能推广到实际应用场景。
AI.motivation: 现有偏见缓解方法主要关注减少生成输出的偏见，通常通过结构化基准评估，存在两个问题：输出级评估无法揭示对齐是否修改了模型的底层表征；结构化基准可能无法反映真实使用场景。需要更全面的评估框架。
AI.method: 提出统一框架，使用相同的中性提示同时分析LLMs的内在和外在性别偏见，直接比较内部表征编码的性别相关信息与生成输出表达的偏见。进一步通过监督微调研究对齐训练的效果，并在故事生成等实际场景中测试。
AI.result: 发现当在统一协议下测量时，潜在性别信息与表达偏见之间存在一致关联。对齐训练确实减少了表达偏见，但内部表征中仍存在可测量的性别相关关联，且可通过对抗性提示重新激活。结构化基准观察到的偏见缓解效果不一定能推广到实际场景如故事生成。
AI.conclusion: 需要超越结构化基准的偏见评估方法，对齐训练虽然减少了输出偏见但未完全消除内部表征的性别关联，表明需要更深入理解偏见缓解机制及其在实际应用中的泛化能力。

title: A^3: Towards Advertising Aesthetic Assessment
summary: Advertising images significantly impact commercial conversion rates and brand equity, yet current evaluation methods rely on subjective judgments, lacking scalability, standardized criteria, and interpretability. To address these challenges, we present A^3 (Advertising Aesthetic Assessment), a comprehensive framework encompassing four components: a paradigm (A^3-Law), a dataset (A^3-Dataset), a multimodal large language model (A^3-Align), and a benchmark (A^3-Bench). Central to A^3 is a theory-driven paradigm, A^3-Law, comprising three hierarchical stages: (1) Perceptual Attention, evaluating perceptual image signals for their ability to attract attention; (2) Formal Interest, assessing formal composition of image color and spatial layout in evoking interest; and (3) Desire Impact, measuring desire evocation from images and their persuasive impact. Building on A^3-Law, we construct A^3-Dataset with 120K instruction-response pairs from 30K advertising images, each richly annotated with multi-dimensional labels and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) rationales. We further develop A^3-Align, trained under A^3-Law with CoT-guided learning on A^3-Dataset. Extensive experiments on A^3-Bench demonstrate that A^3-Align achieves superior alignment with A^3-Law compared to existing models, and this alignment generalizes well to quality advertisement selection and prescriptive advertisement critique, indicating its potential for broader deployment. Dataset, code, and models can be found at: https://github.com/euleryuan/A3-Align.

AI.tldr: A^3框架：一个理论驱动的广告美学评估系统，包含范式、数据集、多模态大语言模型和基准，通过三层评估（感知注意力、形式兴趣、欲望影响）解决当前广告图像评估的主观性、可扩展性和可解释性问题。
AI.motivation: 当前广告图像评估方法依赖主观判断，缺乏可扩展性、标准化标准和可解释性，无法满足商业转化率和品牌资产的需求。
AI.method: 提出A^3框架：1) A^3-Law三层评估范式（感知注意力、形式兴趣、欲望影响）；2) A^3-Dataset包含30K广告图像的120K指令-响应对；3) A^3-Align多模态大语言模型；4) A^3-Bench评估基准。
AI.result: A^3-Align在A^3-Bench上表现出与A^3-Law的优越对齐，这种对齐在优质广告选择和处方式广告批评任务中具有良好泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: A^3框架为广告美学评估提供了理论驱动、可扩展且可解释的解决方案，其模型对齐能力表明具有广泛部署潜力。

title: SemLayer: Semantic-aware Generative Segmentation and Layer Construction for Abstract Icons
summary: Graphic icons are a cornerstone of modern design workflows, yet they are often distributed as flattened single-path or compound-path graphics, where the original semantic layering is lost. This absence of semantic decomposition hinders downstream tasks such as editing, restyling, and animation. We formalize this problem as semantic layer construction for flattened vector art and introduce SemLayer, a visual generation empowered pipeline that restores editable layered structures. Given an abstract icon, SemLayer first generates a chromatically differentiated representation in which distinct semantic components become visually separable. To recover the complete geometry of each part, including occluded regions, we then perform a semantic completion step that reconstructs coherent object-level shapes. Finally, the recovered parts are assembled into a layered vector representation with inferred occlusion relationships. Extensive qualitative comparisons and quantitative evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of SemLayer, enabling editing workflows previously inapplicable to flattened vector graphics and establishing semantic layer reconstruction as a practical and valuable task. Project page: https://xxuhaiyang.github.io/SemLayer/

AI.tldr: SemLayer是一个视觉生成赋能管道，能够从扁平化的矢量图标中恢复可编辑的分层结构，通过色彩区分、语义补全和分层组装来重建语义图层。
AI.motivation: 现代设计工作流中的图形图标通常以扁平化的单路径或复合路径图形分发，原始语义分层信息丢失，这阻碍了编辑、重新样式化和动画等下游任务。
AI.method: 首先生成色彩区分表示使不同语义组件视觉可分离，然后进行语义补全步骤重建完整几何形状（包括被遮挡区域），最后将恢复的部分组装成具有推断遮挡关系的分层矢量表示。
AI.result: 广泛的定性比较和定量评估证明了SemLayer的有效性，能够实现以前不适用于扁平化矢量图形的编辑工作流，并确立语义层重建作为一个实用且有价值的任务。
AI.conclusion: SemLayer成功解决了扁平化矢量艺术的语义层构建问题，为图标编辑和重用提供了新的可能性，将语义层重建确立为设计工作流中的重要任务。

title: A visual observation on the geometry of UMAP projections of the difference vectors of antonym and synonym word pair embeddings
summary:
Antonyms, or opposites, are sometimes defined as \emph{word pairs that have all of the same contextually relevant properties but one}. Seeing how transformer models seem to encode concepts as directions, this begs the question if one can detect ``antonymity'' in the geometry of the embedding vectors of word pairs, especially based on their difference vectors. Such geometrical studies are then naturally contrasted by comparing antonymic pairs to their opposites; synonyms.
  This paper started as an exploratory project on the complexity of the systems needed to detect the geometry of the embedding vectors of antonymic word pairs. What we now report is a curious ``swirl'' that appears across embedding models in a somewhat specific projection configuration.

AI.tldr: 研究发现词向量嵌入中存在一种有趣的"旋涡"几何模式，可用于检测反义词对
AI.motivation: 探索是否能在词嵌入向量的几何结构中检测到反义关系，特别是基于词对差异向量的几何特性
AI.method: 通过分析词嵌入向量的几何结构，在特定投影配置下观察反义词对形成的"旋涡"模式
AI.result: 在不同嵌入模型中发现了这种"旋涡"几何模式，表明反义词对在向量空间中存在特定的几何特征
AI.conclusion: 词嵌入向量的几何结构确实包含反义关系的可检测模式，这为理解语言模型如何编码语义对立关系提供了新视角

title: HAM: A Training-Free Style Transfer Approach via Heterogeneous Attention Modulation for Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models have demonstrated remarkable performance in image generation, particularly within the domain of style transfer. Prevailing style transfer approaches typically leverage pre-trained diffusion models' robust feature extraction capabilities alongside external modular control pathways to explicitly impose style guidance signals. However, these methods often fail to capture complex style reference or retain the identity of user-provided content images, thus falling into the trap of style-content balance. Thus, we propose a training-free style transfer approach via $\textbf{h}$eterogeneous $\textbf{a}$ttention $\textbf{m}$odulation ($\textbf{HAM}$) to protect identity information during image/text-guided style reference transfer, thereby addressing the style-content trade-off challenge. Specifically, we first introduces style noise initialization to initialize latent noise for diffusion. Then, during the diffusion process, it innovatively employs HAM for different attention mechanisms, including Global Attention Regulation (GAR) and Local Attention Transplantation (LAT), which better preserving the details of the content image while capturing complex style references. Our approach is validated through a series of qualitative and quantitative experiments, achieving state-of-the-art performance on multiple quantitative metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出HAM方法，一种无需训练的扩散模型风格迁移技术，通过异构注意力调制解决风格-内容平衡问题，在保护内容图像身份的同时捕捉复杂风格参考。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的风格迁移方法通常依赖预训练模型的特征提取能力和外部控制模块来施加风格指导信号，但这些方法往往难以捕捉复杂风格参考或保留用户提供的内容图像身份，陷入风格-内容平衡困境。
AI.method: 提出训练免费的HAM方法：1) 风格噪声初始化来初始化扩散潜变量；2) 在扩散过程中创新性地使用异构注意力调制，包括全局注意力调节(GAR)和局部注意力移植(LAT)，以更好地保留内容图像细节同时捕捉复杂风格参考。
AI.result: 通过一系列定性和定量实验验证，在多个定量指标上达到最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: HAM方法有效解决了扩散模型风格迁移中的风格-内容权衡挑战，无需训练即可实现高质量的风格迁移，同时保护内容图像的身份信息。

title: Variation is the Norm: Embracing Sociolinguistics in NLP
summary: In Natural Language Processing (NLP), variation is typically seen as noise and "normalised away" before processing, even though it is an integral part of language. Conversely, studying language variation in social contexts is central to sociolinguistics. We present a framework to combine the sociolinguistic dimension of language with the technical dimension of NLP. We argue that by embracing sociolinguistics, variation can actively be included in a research setup, in turn informing the NLP side. To illustrate this, we provide a case study on Luxembourgish, an evolving language featuring a large amount of orthographic variation, demonstrating how NLP performance is impacted. The results show large discrepancies in the performance of models tested and fine-tuned on data with a large amount of orthographic variation in comparison to data closer to the (orthographic) standard. Furthermore, we provide a possible solution to improve the performance by including variation in the fine-tuning process. This case study highlights the importance of including variation in the research setup, as models are currently not robust to occurring variation. Our framework facilitates the inclusion of variation in the thought-process while also being grounded in the theoretical framework of sociolinguistics.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个结合社会语言学与NLP的框架，通过卢森堡语案例研究展示语言变体对NLP性能的影响，并提供包含变体的微调解决方案。
AI.motivation: 传统NLP通常将语言变体视为噪声并加以"规范化"，但这忽略了语言变体作为语言本质组成部分的重要性。社会语言学则专注于研究社会语境中的语言变体。本研究旨在将社会语言学的语言维度与NLP的技术维度相结合。
AI.method: 提出一个结合社会语言学与NLP的框架，通过卢森堡语（一种具有大量正字法变体的演化语言）作为案例研究。比较了在大量正字法变体数据上测试和微调的模型性能与接近（正字法）标准数据的性能差异，并提供了包含变体的微调解决方案。
AI.result: 结果显示，在大量正字法变体数据上测试和微调的模型性能与接近标准数据的模型性能存在巨大差异。包含变体的微调过程可以改善模型性能。当前模型对实际出现的变体不够鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 语言变体应在研究设计中积极纳入，而不是被规范化处理。提出的框架有助于在理论框架内考虑变体，同时基于社会语言学理论基础。这强调了在NLP研究中包含语言变体的重要性。

title: LGEST: Dynamic Spatial-Spectral Expert Routing for Hyperspectral Image Classification
summary: Deep learning methods, including Convolutional Neural Networks, Transformers and Mamba, have achieved remarkable success in hyperspectral image (HSI) classification. Nevertheless, existing methods exhibit inflexible integration of local-global representations, inadequate handling of spectral-spatial scale disparities across heterogeneous bands, and susceptibility to the Hughes phenomenon under high-dimensional sample heterogeneity. To address these challenges, we propose Local-Global Expert Spatial-Spectral Transformer (LGEST), a novel framework that synergistically combines three key innovations. The LGEST first employs a Deep Spatial-Spectral Autoencoder (DSAE) to generate compact yet discriminative embeddings through hierarchical nonlinear compression, preserving 3D neighborhood coherence while mitigating information loss in high-dimensional spaces. Secondly, a Cross-Interactive Mixed Expert Feature Pyramid (CIEM-FPN) leverages cross-attention mechanisms and residual mixture-of-experts layers to dynamically fuse multi-scale features, adaptively weighting spectral discriminability and spatial saliency through learnable gating functions. Finally, a Local-Global Expert System (LGES) processes decomposed features via sparsely activated expert pairs: convolutional sub-experts capture fine-grained textures, while transformer sub-experts model long-range contextual dependencies, with a routing controller dynamically selecting experts based on real-time feature saliency. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets demonstrate that LGEST consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: LGEST是一个用于高光谱图像分类的新型深度学习框架，通过深度空间-光谱自编码器、交叉交互混合专家特征金字塔和局部-全局专家系统三个关键创新，解决了现有方法在局部-全局表示融合、光谱-空间尺度差异处理和小样本高维异质性方面的挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有高光谱图像分类方法存在三个主要问题：1）局部-全局表示融合不够灵活；2）对异质波段间光谱-空间尺度差异处理不足；3）在高维样本异质性下容易受到休斯现象的影响。这些问题限制了分类性能的提升。
AI.method: LGEST框架包含三个核心组件：1）深度空间-光谱自编码器（DSAE）通过分层非线性压缩生成紧凑且具有判别性的嵌入；2）交叉交互混合专家特征金字塔（CIEM-FPN）利用交叉注意力机制和残差混合专家层动态融合多尺度特征；3）局部-全局专家系统（LGES）通过稀疏激活的专家对处理分解特征，卷积子专家捕获细粒度纹理，变换器子专家建模长距离上下文依赖。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，LGEST始终优于最先进的方法，证明了其在处理高光谱图像分类任务中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: LGEST通过创新的架构设计有效解决了高光谱图像分类中的关键挑战，为深度学习在该领域的应用提供了新的解决方案，在多个数据集上取得了优异的性能表现。

title: Stance Labels Fail When They Matter Most: The Projection Problem in Stance Detection
summary: Stance detection is nearly always formulated as classifying text into Favor, Against, or Neutral -- a convention inherited from debate analysis and applied without modification to social media since SemEval-2016. But attitudes toward complex targets are not unitary: a person can accept climate science while opposing carbon taxes, expressing support on one dimension and opposition on another. When annotators must compress such multi-dimensional attitudes into a single label, different annotators weight different dimensions -- producing disagreement that reflects not confusion but different compression choices. We call this the \textbf{projection problem}, and show that its cost is conditional: when a text's dimensions align, any weighting yields the same label and three-way annotation works well; when dimensions conflict, label agreement collapses while agreement on individual dimensions remains intact. A pilot study on SemEval-2016 Task 6 confirms this crossover: on dimension-consistent texts, label agreement (Krippendorff's $α= 0.307$) exceeds dimensional agreement ($α= 0.082$); on dimension-conflicting texts, the pattern reverses -- label $α$ drops to $0.085$ while dimensional $α$ rises to $0.334$, with Policy reaching $0.572$. The projection problem is real -- but it activates precisely where it matters most.

AI.tldr: 论文指出立场检测中传统的三分类方法存在"投影问题"：当文本包含多维态度时，不同标注者会基于不同维度权重给出不同标签，导致标注不一致。这种不一致并非标注混淆，而是多维态度压缩为单一标签时产生的必然结果。
AI.motivation: 立场检测领域长期沿用辩论分析中的三分类方法（支持、反对、中立），但这种方法在处理复杂目标的多维态度时存在问题。当人们对复杂目标（如气候变化）在不同维度上有不同态度时，传统方法要求标注者将多维态度压缩为单一标签，导致标注不一致。
AI.method: 通过分析SemEval-2016 Task 6的标注数据，研究标注一致性在维度一致文本和维度冲突文本中的变化。使用Krippendorff's α系数分别测量标签层面和维度层面的标注一致性。
AI.result: 在维度一致的文本中，标签一致性（α=0.307）高于维度一致性（α=0.082）；而在维度冲突的文本中，模式反转：标签一致性降至α=0.085，而维度一致性升至α=0.334，其中政策维度达到α=0.572。这表明标注不一致主要发生在态度维度冲突的情况下。
AI.conclusion: "投影问题"确实存在，但它在最关键的地方被激活。当文本的多维态度一致时，三分类方法有效；当态度维度冲突时，标签层面的标注一致性崩溃，而维度层面的标注一致性仍然保持。这表明需要重新思考立场检测的标注框架。

title: Beyond Semantic Priors: Mitigating Optimization Collapse for Generalizable Visual Forensics
summary: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) like CLIP have emerged as a dominant paradigm for generalizable deepfake detection, a representational disconnect remains: their semantic-centric pre-training is ill-suited for capturing non-semantic artifacts inherent to hyper-realistic synthesis. In this work, we identify a failure mode termed Optimization Collapse, where detectors trained with Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) degenerate to random guessing on non-semantic forgeries once the perturbation radius exceeds a narrow threshold. To theoretically formalize this collapse, we propose the Critical Optimization Radius (COR) to quantify the geometric stability of the optimization landscape, and leverage the Gradient Signal-to-Noise Ratio (GSNR) to measure generalization potential. We establish a theorem proving that COR increases monotonically with GSNR, thereby revealing that the geometric instability of SAM optimization originates from degraded intrinsic generalization potential. This result identifies the layer-wise attenuation of GSNR as the root cause of Optimization Collapse in detecting non-semantic forgeries. Although naively reducing perturbation radius yields stable convergence under SAM, it merely treats the symptom without mitigating the intrinsic generalization degradation, necessitating enhanced gradient fidelity. Building on this insight, we propose the Contrastive Regional Injection Transformer (CoRIT), which integrates a computationally efficient Contrastive Gradient Proxy (CGP) with three training-free strategies: Region Refinement Mask to suppress CGP variance, Regional Signal Injection to preserve CGP magnitude, and Hierarchical Representation Integration to attain more generalizable representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CoRIT mitigates optimization collapse and achieves state-of-the-art generalization across cross-domain and universal forgery benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文发现基于SAM训练的深度伪造检测器在非语义伪造上存在"优化崩溃"问题，提出COR理论框架量化优化稳定性，并通过GSNR分析泛化潜力，最终设计CoRIT方法缓解崩溃并提升跨域检测性能。
AI.motivation: 当前基于视觉语言模型（如CLIP）的深度伪造检测存在表示鸿沟：其语义中心的预训练不适合捕捉超现实合成中的非语义伪影。研究发现使用SAM训练的检测器在非语义伪造上会出现"优化崩溃"现象，一旦扰动半径超过阈值就会退化到随机猜测水平。
AI.method: 提出临界优化半径（COR）理论框架量化优化几何稳定性，利用梯度信噪比（GSNR）衡量泛化潜力。基于理论分析，设计对比区域注入Transformer（CoRIT），包含计算高效的对比梯度代理（CGP）和三种免训练策略：区域细化掩码（抑制CGP方差）、区域信号注入（保持CGP幅度）和层次表示集成（获得更泛化的表示）。
AI.result: 实验表明CoRIT能够有效缓解优化崩溃问题，在跨域和通用伪造基准测试中实现了最先进的泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了SAM优化在非语义伪造检测中的几何不稳定性源于内在泛化潜力的退化，提出的CoRIT方法通过增强梯度保真度解决了优化崩溃问题，为深度伪造检测提供了更稳健的解决方案。

title: Optimizing Multilingual LLMs via Federated Learning: A Study of Client Language Composition
summary: Federated Learning (FL) of Large Language Models (LLMs) in multilingual environments presents significant challenges stemming from heterogeneous language distributions across clients and disparities in language resource availability. To address these challenges, we extended the FederatedScope-LLM framework to support multilingual instruction-tuning experiments with LLMs. We also introduced a novel client-specific early stopping mechanism, Local Dynamic Early Stopping (LDES-FL), which allows clients to pause and resume local training based on client-side validation performance, enhancing training efficiency and sustainability. Through a series of experiments, we studied how client language composition - from fully monolingual to increasingly multilingual clients - affects multilingual quality, fairness and training cost. Monolingual local fine-tuning remains the most effective for single-language specialization, whereas federated training is better suited to learning a single balanced multilingual model. In FL, increasing within-client multilinguality leads to stronger and fairer global models, narrows the gap to centralized multilingual fine-tuning, and yields the largest gains for lower-resource languages, albeit at the cost of more optimization steps. Overall, our results identify client language composition as a key design variable in multilingual FL, shaping performance, fairness and efficiency

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多语言环境下大语言模型的联邦学习，通过扩展FederatedScope-LLM框架并引入本地动态早停机制，探讨了客户端语言组成对多语言质量、公平性和训练成本的影响。
AI.motivation: 多语言环境下的大语言模型联邦学习面临客户端语言分布异构和语言资源可用性差异的挑战，需要研究如何优化训练效率和模型性能。
AI.method: 扩展FederatedScope-LLM框架支持多语言指令调优实验，引入客户端特定的本地动态早停机制（LDES-FL），允许客户端基于本地验证性能暂停和恢复训练。
AI.result: 单语言本地微调对单一语言专业化最有效，而联邦训练更适合学习平衡的多语言模型。增加客户端内多语言性会带来更强、更公平的全局模型，缩小与集中式多语言微调的差距，对低资源语言收益最大，但需要更多优化步骤。
AI.conclusion: 客户端语言组成是多语言联邦学习的关键设计变量，影响性能、公平性和效率。增加客户端内多语言性可提升模型质量和公平性，但需权衡训练成本。

title: Semantic Centroids and Hierarchical Density-Based Clustering for Cross-Document Software Coreference Resolution
summary: This paper describes the system submitted to the SOMD 2026 Shared Task for Cross-Document Coreference Resolution (CDCR) of software mentions. Our approach addresses the challenge of identifying and clustering inconsistent software mentions across scientific corpora. We propose a hybrid framework that combines dense semantic embeddings from a pre-trained Sentence-BERT model, Knowledge Base (KB) lookup strategy built from training-set cluster centroids using FAISS for efficient retrieval, and HDBSCAN density-based clustering for mentions that cannot be confidently assigned to existing clusters. Surface-form normalization and abbreviation resolution are applied to improve canonical name matching. The same core pipeline is applied to Subtasks 1 and 2. To address the large scale settings of Subtask 3, the pipeline was adapted by utilising a blocking strategy based on entity types and canonicalized surface forms. Our system achieved CoNLL F1 scores of 0.98, 0.98, and 0.96 on Subtasks 1, 2, and 3 respectively.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个用于软件提及跨文档共指消解的混合框架，结合了语义嵌入、知识库查找和密度聚类方法，在SOMD 2026共享任务的三个子任务中取得了高准确率。
AI.motivation: 解决科学文献中软件提及不一致的问题，实现跨文档的软件实体识别和聚类，以支持软件引用分析和知识发现。
AI.method: 采用混合框架：1) 使用预训练的Sentence-BERT模型获取密集语义嵌入；2) 基于训练集聚类中心构建知识库，使用FAISS进行高效检索；3) 对无法确定分配到现有聚类的提及使用HDBSCAN密度聚类；4) 应用表面形式归一化和缩写解析；5) 对于大规模子任务3，采用基于实体类型和规范化表面形式的阻塞策略。
AI.result: 在SOMD 2026共享任务的三个子任务中取得了优异的CoNLL F1分数：子任务1为0.98，子任务2为0.98，子任务3为0.96。
AI.conclusion: 提出的混合框架有效解决了跨文档软件提及共指消解问题，特别是在大规模设置下通过阻塞策略保持了高性能，证明了语义嵌入、知识库和聚类方法结合的有效性。

title: PosterIQ: A Design Perspective Benchmark for Poster Understanding and Generation
summary: We present PosterIQ, a design-driven benchmark for poster understanding and generation, annotated across composition structure, typographic hierarchy, and semantic intent. It includes 7,765 image-annotation instances and 822 generation prompts spanning real, professional, and synthetic cases. To bridge visual design cognition and generative modeling, we define tasks for layout parsing, text-image correspondence, typography/readability and font perception, design quality assessment, and controllable, composition-aware generation with metaphor. We evaluate state-of-the-art MLLMs and diffusion-based generators, finding persistent gaps in visual hierarchy, typographic semantics, saliency control, and intention communication; commercial models lead on high-level reasoning but act as insensitive automatic raters, while generators render text well yet struggle with composition-aware synthesis. Extensive analyses show PosterIQ is both a quantitative benchmark and a diagnostic tool for design reasoning, offering reproducible, task-specific metrics. We aim to catalyze models' creativity and integrate human-centred design principles into generative vision-language systems.

AI.tldr: PosterIQ是一个用于海报理解和生成的设计驱动基准，包含7,765个图像-标注实例和822个生成提示，涵盖真实、专业和合成案例，评估模型在视觉层次、排版语义等方面的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型在海报设计方面存在视觉层次理解、排版语义、显著性控制和意图传达等方面的不足，需要建立专门的基准来评估和改进模型的设计认知能力。
AI.method: 构建包含7,765个图像-标注实例和822个生成提示的数据集，定义布局解析、图文对应、排版/可读性、字体感知、设计质量评估以及可控的、具有构图意识的隐喻生成等任务。
AI.result: 评估发现最先进的MLLMs和基于扩散的生成模型在视觉层次、排版语义、显著性控制和意图传达方面存在持续差距；商业模型在高层次推理方面领先但作为评分器不够敏感，生成器能很好渲染文字但在构图感知合成方面有困难。
AI.conclusion: PosterIQ既是量化基准也是设计推理的诊断工具，提供可重复的、任务特定的指标，旨在促进模型的创造力并将以人为中心的设计原则整合到生成视觉语言系统中。

title: When Understanding Becomes a Risk: Authenticity and Safety Risks in the Emerging Image Generation Paradigm
summary: Recently, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have emerged as a unified paradigm for language and image generation. Compared with diffusion models, MLLMs possess a much stronger capability for semantic understanding, enabling them to process more complex textual inputs and comprehend richer contextual meanings. However, this enhanced semantic ability may also introduce new and potentially greater safety risks. Taking diffusion models as a reference point, we systematically analyze and compare the safety risks of emerging MLLMs along two dimensions: unsafe content generation and fake image synthesis. Across multiple unsafe generation benchmark datasets, we observe that MLLMs tend to generate more unsafe images than diffusion models. This difference partly arises because diffusion models often fail to interpret abstract prompts, producing corrupted outputs, whereas MLLMs can comprehend these prompts and generate unsafe content. For current advanced fake image detectors, MLLM-generated images are also notably harder to identify. Even when detectors are retrained with MLLMs-specific data, they can still be bypassed by simply providing MLLMs with longer and more descriptive inputs. Our measurements indicate that the emerging safety risks of the cutting-edge generative paradigm, MLLMs, have not been sufficiently recognized, posing new challenges to real-world safety.

AI.tldr: MLLMs相比扩散模型有更强的语义理解能力，但这也带来了更大的安全风险，包括更多不安全内容生成和更难以检测的伪造图像。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）作为语言和图像生成的统一范式，相比扩散模型具有更强的语义理解能力，能够处理更复杂的文本输入和理解更丰富的上下文含义。然而，这种增强的语义能力可能引入新的、潜在更大的安全风险。
AI.method: 以扩散模型为参照点，从两个维度系统分析和比较新兴MLLMs的安全风险：不安全内容生成和伪造图像合成。在多个不安全生成基准数据集上进行评估，并测试当前先进的伪造图像检测器对MLLM生成图像的识别能力。
AI.result: 在多个不安全生成基准数据集上，MLLMs倾向于生成比扩散模型更多的不安全图像。这种差异部分源于扩散模型经常无法解释抽象提示，产生损坏的输出，而MLLMs能够理解这些提示并生成不安全内容。对于当前先进的伪造图像检测器，MLLM生成的图像也明显更难识别。即使检测器使用MLLMs特定数据进行重新训练，仍然可以通过为MLLMs提供更长、更详细的输入来绕过检测。
AI.conclusion: 新兴的尖端生成范式MLLMs的安全风险尚未得到充分认识，这给现实世界的安全带来了新的挑战。需要更深入的研究和更有效的安全措施来应对MLLMs带来的安全威胁。

title: GameplayQA: A Benchmarking Framework for Decision-Dense POV-Synced Multi-Video Understanding of 3D Virtual Agents
summary: Multimodal LLMs are increasingly deployed as perceptual backbones for autonomous agents in 3D environments, from robotics to virtual worlds. These applications require agents to perceive rapid state changes, attribute actions to the correct entities, and reason about concurrent multi-agent behaviors from a first-person perspective, capabilities that existing benchmarks do not adequately evaluate. We introduce GameplayQA, a framework for evaluating agentic-centric perception and reasoning through video understanding. Specifically, we densely annotate multiplayer 3D gameplay videos at 1.22 labels/second, with time-synced, concurrent captions of states, actions, and events structured around a triadic system of Self, Other Agents, and the World, a natural decomposition for multi-agent environments. From these annotations, we refined 2.4K diagnostic QA pairs organized into three levels of cognitive complexity, accompanied by a structured distractor taxonomy that enables fine-grained analysis of where models hallucinate. Evaluation of frontier MLLMs reveals a substantial gap from human performance, with common failures in temporal and cross-video grounding, agent-role attribution, and handling the decision density of the game. We hope GameplayQA stimulates future research at the intersection of embodied AI, agentic perception, and world modeling.

AI.tldr: GameplayQA是一个用于评估多模态大语言模型在3D多智能体环境中感知和推理能力的新基准，通过密集标注的游戏视频和结构化问答对来测试模型的时间定位、智能体角色归因等关键能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基准无法充分评估多模态LLM在3D多智能体环境中的关键能力，如感知快速状态变化、正确归因行为到相应实体、从第一人称视角推理并发多智能体行为等，这些能力对于自主智能体在机器人学和虚拟世界中的应用至关重要。
AI.method: 创建了GameplayQA框架，密集标注多人3D游戏视频（每秒1.22个标签），使用时间同步的并发标注来描述状态、动作和事件，围绕自我、其他智能体和世界的三元系统进行结构化组织。从这些标注中提炼出2.4K个诊断性问答对，分为三个认知复杂度级别，并配有结构化干扰项分类法。
AI.result: 评估前沿多模态大语言模型显示，与人类性能存在显著差距，常见失败包括时间和跨视频定位、智能体角色归因以及处理游戏决策密度等方面的问题。
AI.conclusion: GameplayQA为评估智能体中心感知和推理提供了一个有价值的基准，揭示了当前多模态LLM在复杂多智能体环境理解方面的局限性，有望推动具身AI、智能体感知和世界建模交叉领域的研究进展。

title: LGTM: Training-Free Light-Guided Text-to-Image Diffusion Model via Initial Noise Manipulation
summary: Diffusion models have demonstrated high-quality performance in conditional text-to-image generation, particularly with structural cues such as edges, layouts, and depth. However, lighting conditions have received limited attention and remain difficult to control within the generative process. Existing methods handle lighting through a two-stage pipeline that relights images after generation, which is inefficient. Moreover, they rely on fine-tuning with large datasets and heavy computation, limiting their adaptability to new models and tasks. To address this, we propose a novel Training-Free Light-Guided Text-to-Image Diffusion Model via Initial Noise Manipulation (LGTM), which manipulates the initial latent noise of the diffusion process to guide image generation with text prompts and user-specified light directions. Through a channel-wise analysis of the latent space, we find that selectively manipulating latent channels enables fine-grained lighting control without fine-tuning or modifying the pre-trained model. Extensive experiments show that our method surpasses prompt-based baselines in lighting consistency, while preserving image quality and text alignment. This approach introduces new possibilities for dynamic, user-guided light control. Furthermore, it integrates seamlessly with models like ControlNet, demonstrating adaptability across diverse scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的基于初始噪声操控的光照引导文本到图像扩散模型（LGTM），通过选择性操控潜在空间通道实现细粒度光照控制，无需微调或修改预训练模型。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在条件文本到图像生成中表现出色，但光照条件控制有限。现有方法采用两阶段流程（先生成后重光照），效率低下且依赖大规模数据集微调和大量计算，限制了新模型和任务的适应性。
AI.method: 提出LGTM方法，通过操控扩散过程的初始潜在噪声，结合文本提示和用户指定的光照方向引导图像生成。通过对潜在空间进行通道级分析，选择性操控特定通道实现细粒度光照控制，无需微调或修改预训练模型。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法在光照一致性方面超越了基于提示的基线方法，同时保持了图像质量和文本对齐。该方法还能与ControlNet等模型无缝集成，展示了跨多样化场景的适应性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为动态、用户引导的光照控制开辟了新可能性，通过初始噪声操控实现了无需训练的高效光照引导，具有良好的扩展性和适应性。

title: Improving Lean4 Autoformalization via Cycle Consistency Fine-tuning
summary: Autoformalization - automatically translating natural language mathematical texts into formal proof language such as Lean4 - can help accelerate AI-assisted mathematical research, be it via proof verification or proof search. I fine-tune Qwen3.5-2B with LoRA for natural language to Lean4 formalization on FineLeanCorpus and consider three training regimes: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with curriculum learning (difficulty 1 to 10), SFT without curriculum ordering, and reinforcement learning using group relative policy optimization (GRPO) with a cycle consistency reward. Cycle consistency measures how well the meaning of a statement is preserved through a NL to Lean4 to NL' loop, computed as cosine similarity of off-the-shelf sentence embeddings. On an unseen subset of FineLeanCorpus (FLC) and on PutnamBench, RL substantially outperforms both SFT variants (mean cycle consistency 0.669 vs. 0.513 on FLC; 0.561 vs. 0.422 on PutnamBench), while increasing cross-entropy loss by only 0.011 nats, with minimal impact on formalization quality. Curriculum ordering provides no measurable benefit over shuffled training.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过三种训练策略（带课程学习的SFT、无课程SFT、基于GRPO的强化学习）微调Qwen3.5-2B模型，实现自然语言数学文本到Lean4形式化语言的自动转换。强化学习方法在保持语义一致性方面显著优于监督微调。
AI.motivation: 自动形式化（将自然语言数学文本转换为Lean4等形式化证明语言）可以加速AI辅助的数学研究，无论是通过证明验证还是证明搜索。当前需要更有效的方法来实现高质量的自然语言到形式化语言的转换。
AI.method: 使用Qwen3.5-2B模型，在FineLeanCorpus数据集上进行微调，比较三种训练策略：1）带课程学习的监督微调（难度1-10）；2）无课程排序的监督微调；3）使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）的强化学习，采用循环一致性奖励（通过NL→Lean4→NL'循环的余弦相似度计算）。
AI.result: 强化学习方法在未见过的FineLeanCorpus子集和PutnamBench上显著优于两种监督微调变体（FLC上平均循环一致性0.669 vs 0.513；PutnamBench上0.561 vs 0.422），仅增加0.011 nats的交叉熵损失，对形式化质量影响最小。课程排序相比随机训练没有提供可测量的优势。
AI.conclusion: 基于GRPO的强化学习方法在自动形式化任务中表现最佳，能够更好地保持语义一致性，而课程学习在此任务中没有明显优势。该方法为AI辅助数学研究提供了有效的自动形式化解决方案。

title: LaDy: Lagrangian-Dynamic Informed Network for Skeleton-based Action Segmentation via Spatial-Temporal Modulation
summary: Skeleton-based Temporal Action Segmentation (STAS) aims to densely parse untrimmed skeletal sequences into frame-level action categories. However, existing methods, while proficient at capturing spatio-temporal kinematics, neglect the underlying physical dynamics that govern human motion. This oversight limits inter-class discriminability between actions with similar kinematics but distinct dynamic intents, and hinders precise boundary localization where dynamic force profiles shift. To address these, we propose the Lagrangian-Dynamic Informed Network (LaDy), a framework integrating principles of Lagrangian dynamics into the segmentation process. Specifically, LaDy first computes generalized coordinates from joint positions and then estimates Lagrangian terms under physical constraints to explicitly synthesize the generalized forces. To further ensure physical coherence, our Energy Consistency Loss enforces the work-energy theorem, aligning kinetic energy change with the work done by the net force. The learned dynamics then drive a Spatio-Temporal Modulation module: Spatially, generalized forces are fused with spatial representations to provide more discriminative semantics. Temporally, salient dynamic signals are constructed for temporal gating, thereby significantly enhancing boundary awareness. Experiments on challenging datasets show that LaDy achieves state-of-the-art performance, validating the integration of physical dynamics for action segmentation. Code is available at https://github.com/HaoyuJi/LaDy.

AI.tldr: LaDy框架将拉格朗日动力学原理融入骨骼时序动作分割，通过物理约束下的广义力合成和能量一致性损失，提升相似动作的区分能力和边界定位精度。
AI.motivation: 现有骨骼时序动作分割方法主要关注时空运动学特征，但忽略了控制人体运动的物理动力学原理，这导致具有相似运动学但不同动态意图的动作类别难以区分，且动态力分布变化的边界定位不精确。
AI.method: 提出拉格朗日动力学信息网络(LaDy)：1)从关节位置计算广义坐标；2)在物理约束下估计拉格朗日项以显式合成广义力；3)通过能量一致性损失强制功-能定理，使动能变化与净力做功一致；4)学习到的动力学驱动时空调制模块：空间上融合广义力与空间表示，时间上构建显著动态信号进行时序门控。
AI.result: 在多个具有挑战性的数据集上，LaDy实现了最先进的性能，验证了物理动力学整合对动作分割的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将拉格朗日动力学原理整合到动作分割过程中，能够显著提升相似动作的区分能力和边界定位精度，为骨骼时序动作分割提供了新的物理动力学视角。

title: Towards Reward Modeling for AI Tutors in Math Mistake Remediation
summary: Evaluating the pedagogical quality of AI tutors remains challenging: standard NLG metrics do not determine whether responses identify mistakes, scaffold reasoning, or avoid revealing the answers. For the task of mistake remediation, we derive a hierarchy of pedagogical aspects from human pairwise preferences on MRBench, and synthesize minimally contrastive response pairs that differ along key aspects (e.g., mistake identification and location, targetedness, scaffolding, actionability, clarity, and coherence). We develop and release Bradley-Terry preference models trained on weighted-sum rankings that we automatically create from MRBench, synthetic pairs, and data combinations. Using only synthetic data, our best model reaches 0.69 pairwise accuracy on a human preference test, and combining weighted-sum data with targeted synthetic groups improves accuracy to 0.74, outperforming larger general-purpose reward models while using only a 0.5B-parameter backbone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种评估AI导师教学质量的框架，通过合成最小对比响应对来量化教学维度，并开发了基于Bradley-Terry模型的偏好模型，在人类偏好测试中达到0.74的准确率。
